skills.name: Bloodfest
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

If Jackie deals damage with basic attacks or skills, she makes her target Bleed. Bleeding targets take damage over time for a certain amount of time. At max stacks or when she assists in a kill, she enters an <color=white>Adrenaline Burst</color> state. In this state, each time she deals damage with basic attacks or skills she applies Bleeding at max stacks, dealing additional skill damage and healing based on her lost HP.

skills.name: Hack & Slash
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown

Jackie dashes in the targeted direction and swings her weapon, dealing skill damage and recovering health based on her damage dealt. She deals increased damage to targets at max Bleeding stacks. If she hits the enemy with the skill, she can reuse it.

skills.name: Crippler
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 6 Seconds Cooldown

Jackie's next basic attack is enhanced, dealing additional skill damage and slowing targets.

skills.name: Leaping Strike
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 16 Seconds Cooldown

<color=green>Passive:</color> When Jackie assists to kill an enemy character her cooldown of <color=white>Leaping Strike</color> is reset. Hitting targets at max Bleeding stacks with a basic attack reduces the skill's cooldown. Jackie jumps to the targeted location, dealing skill damage to enemies nearby.

skills.name: Chainsaw Murderer
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 70 Seconds Cooldown

Jackie starts her deadly chainsaw. Her movement speed and attack speed are increased. The duration of the effects is increased if she assists killing enemy characters. When she reuses the skill while active, she can use <color=white>Massacre</color>. <color=white>Massacre:</color> Jackie swings the chainsaw in a large area around her, dealing skill damage based on enemy's lost HP and healing for a portion of the damage dealt. When she assists killing enemy characters, she can reuse <color=white>Massacre</color>.

skills.name: Massacre
skills.tooltip: No Cost

skills.name: Aya's Justice
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 25 Seconds Cooldown

If Aya is attacked, a protective film envelops her for a moment and blocks damage. Attacking an enemy reduces the cooldown of Aya's Justice a bit.

skills.name: Double Shot
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 10 Seconds Cooldown

Aya rapidly shoots her target twice. Her attack speed increases for a certain amount of time.

skills.name: Steady Shot
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 10 Seconds Cooldown

Aya shoots ten times in the targeted direction for a moment. The number of shots fired increases with additional Attack Speed.

skills.name: Moving Turn
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 15 Seconds Cooldown

Aya quickly dashes in the targeted direction and the cooldown of <color=white>Double Shot</color> and <color=white>Steady Shot</color> is restored.

skills.name: Blank Cartridge
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Aya fires a blank into the air, dealing skill damage to nearby enemies and Fearing them.

skills.name: Touché
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Every time Fiora damages an enemy with a skill, she applies a stack of Touché. Hitting an enemy with a skill when Touché is at max stacks, deals additional skill damage, heals Fiora and briefly increases her movement speed before slowing her. The remaining cooldown of Fiora's basic skill is reduced.

skills.name: Fente
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 8 Seconds Cooldown

Fiora stabs in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage to enemies hit. The edge of the skill deals additional damage, slows enemies, and applies 2 stacks of Touché.

skills.name: Attaque Composée
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 7 Seconds Cooldown

Fiora swings her weapon twice at the targeted direction, dealing skill damage twice.

skills.name: Marche & Rompre
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 8.5 Seconds Cooldown

Marche: Fiora dashes in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage. If she hits an enemy, she can use her Rompre skill. Rompre: Fiora dashes in the targeted direction.

skills.name: Flèche
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 70 Seconds Cooldown

Fiora attacks with a short dash in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage and slowing enemies it hits. If she's close enough to the enemy, she'll cast the skill in place. Flèche can be used up to 2 additional times. When used last, it deals stronger skill damage and stuns the enemy.

skills.name: Tough Body
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Magnus's defense increases each time his skills or basic attacks hit. At max stacks, his HP recovery increases.

skills.name: Broken Bullet
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 11 Seconds Cooldown

Magnus slams the ground and launches a rock towards his enemies. Targets hit by the rock are slowed.

skills.name: 17 vs 1
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

Magnus spins his weapon, dealing damage to all enemies in an area around him. He spins his weapon even faster when he gets additional defense. Hitting enemies reduces its cooldown. Duration of Crowd Control increases when the skill is active.

skills.name: Heavy Strike
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 11 Seconds Cooldown

Magnus smashes the enemy target, dealing skill damage and knocking them left of the direction he faces. If the enemy hits the wall, they take additional skill damage and are stunned.

skills.name: Bike From Hell
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Magnus turns on his bike and starts to ride, gaining stacks of Tough Body. The bike slowly becomes faster. If the bike runs into a player or wall, they take skill damage. Reactivate to jump off of the bike and launch it forward.

skills.name: Eye of Azrael
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

If Zahir hits an enemy with a skill, they are marked with Eye of Azrael, granting Zahir vision of the enemy. Zahir's movement speed is increased. If you hit an enemy with Eye of Azrael, it deals extra skill damage and an Eye of Azrael effect is applied to the skill used.

skills.name: Narayanastra
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 6 Seconds Cooldown

Zahir calls upon God's strength, dealing damage in a targeted area. Eye of Azrael effect: Narayanastra deals extra damage.

skills.name: Gandiva
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 0.55 Seconds Cooldown (8 Seconds Charging Time)

Zahir throws a Chakram in the targeted direction, dealing damage. Zahir gains 1 Chakram periodically and if he hits an enemy with any skill but Gandiva, he gains 2 Chakram. Eye of Azrael effect: Hitting an enemy reduces the cooldown of Narayanastra and Vayvayastra.

skills.name: Vayvayastra
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 15 Seconds Cooldown

Zahir summons and launches a gust of wind, dealing damage. Enemies hit are launched airborne. Eye of Azrael effect: The enemy is launched airborne for longer.

skills.name: Bhargavastra
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Zahir calls down Chakrams from the heavens in the targeted direction, dealing damage. Bhargavastra marks enemies with Eye of Azrael if they don't have one.

skills.name: Wild
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Nadine gains a Wild stacks when she assists on Wild Animals and Test Subject kills.

skills.name: Bullseye
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 7 Seconds Cooldown

Nadine gathers her strength, reducing her movement speed, and gradually increasing the range and damage of Bullseye. Reactivate the skill to shoot the arrow, dealing skill damage.

skills.name: Squirrel Trap
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

Nadine throws a Squirrel Trap at the targeted location. Reactivate to throw a second trap within the reinstallation range and deal skill damage to enemies caught in the connected traps. Enemies are slowed and have their Attack Speed reduced, and Nadine gains vision of them. Enemies slowed by Squirrel Trap take reduced skill damage from consecutive Squirrel Traps. The connected traps disappear after a certain time.

skills.name: Monkey Wire
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 16 Seconds Cooldown

Nadine attaches a wire at the targeted location. While installed and she is attached to it, her attack speed increases. Reactivate to dash to the anchor point of the wire and increase her attack speed.

skills.name: Wolf Assault
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Nadine summons a wolf every few basic attacks. The wolf attacks the enemy, dealing skill damage, slowing them, and reducing their attack speed. Nadine deals more damage the more Wild stacks she has. Her skill duration increases when she enemy kill assists.

skills.name: Dogfight
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Hyunwoo gains stacks of Dogfight when attacking an enemy. When reaching a certain number of stacks, Hyunwoo's next attack deals extra damage, restores his HP, and reduces the cooldown of <color=white>Bluff</color>.

skills.name: Stomping Foot
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 7 Seconds Cooldown

Hyunwoo stomps his foot very hard, dealing damage and slowing enemies in the targeted area for a moment. Hitting an enemy with the skill increases Hyunwoo's movement speed.

skills.name: Bluff
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 15 Seconds Cooldown

Hyunwoo bluffs his hand, gaining extra defense, immunity to movement impairing effects, and activating <color=white>Dogfight</color>. Basic attacks on Hyunwoo during Bluff grant him stacks of <color=white>Dogfight</color>.

skills.name: First Attack
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

Hyunwoo charges toward the targeted direction, dealing damage and knocking enemies in his path back. If an enemy collides with a wall, they are stunned for a moment.

skills.name: Haymaker
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 60 Seconds Cooldown

Hyunwoo gathers his strength and throws a powerful punch, dealing considerable damage and reducing defense based on charge time. After, he knocks them back slightly. When fully charged, he pushes the target out of range and stuns them.

skills.name: Feedback
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Hart's basic attacks releases additional sound waves, dealing basic attack damage.

skills.name: Delay
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 4 Seconds Cooldown

Hart strums her guitar, releasing a sound wave. She can reuse this skill twice. Upon reuse: The released sound wave deals skill damage to enemies hit. Enemies hit by both sound waves are slowed.

skills.name: Overdrive
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

Hart plays a lick on her guitar, increasing her Attack Power and Basic Attack Range for a certain period of time.

skills.name: Flanger
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

Hart moves a short distance toward the targeted location and releases a sound wave at nearby enemies, skill dealing damage. This skill can be reused once.

skills.name: Peacemaker
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Hart summons her amplifiers to put on a show, keeping all her targets in the area alive. Targets whose HP drops below a certain level can't take damage or recover HP. Once the show is over, all targets in the area recover HP.

skills.name: Guerilla Warfare
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Attack power or skill amplification increases for a certain period of time if enemies are hit by his traps.

skills.name: Semtex Bomb
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 11 Seconds Cooldown

Isol throws a bomb to the target location that sticks to an enemy or on the ground. The bomb explodes and grants vision, dealing damage, and rooting enemies caught in the blast. If the bomb is stuck to an enemy, each attack reduces its timer and increases the damage and root duration.

skills.name: Rebel Assault
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown

Isol unleashes a fury of bullets in front of him, dealing skill damage, and reducing enemies defense.

skills.name: Camouflage
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

Isol rolls forward and blends into his surroundings, going invisible. The invisibility is lifted after a certain time or if Isol does any action other than movement. The first basic attack damage within a certain amount of time deals an additional skill damage.

skills.name: MOK Operational Mine
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 30 Seconds Cooldown

Isol installs a MOK Operational Mine on the ground. The mine explodes when an enemy enters its range, dealing damage.

skills.name: Blood Alcohol Content (BAC)
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Li Dailin can use <color=white>Drink Up</color> to fill her BAC bar. Depending on her BAC, she can trigger <color=white>Dialed In</color>. <color=white>Dialed In:</color> Li Dailin's Attack Speed is increased and she attacks with two consecutive basic attacks. <color=white>When her BAC is over 40,</color> Li Dailin gets drunk. Her <color=white>Spirited Kick</color> and <color=white>Bottom Shelf</color> skills become enhanced with <color=yellow>Tipsy.</color> She gains Dialed In for her next basic attack after using a basic skill. <color=white>When her BAC is 100,</color> she becomes Inebriated and cannot use her skills for a certain amount of time. While she is Inebriated, she gains Dialed In. Li Dailin's attack power is slightly increased for a certain amout of time when she drinks <color=#C4C4C4>Flower Liquor</color>.

skills.name: Spirited Kick
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 13 Seconds Cooldown

Li Dailin charges forward, dealing damage to enemies hit. She can reactivate this skill two more times. <color=yellow>Tipsy:</color> Consumes BAC to increase range and damage dealt.

skills.name: Drink Up
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 9 Seconds Cooldown

Li Dailin takes a drink, gaining Liquid Strength, and increasing her BAC. While drinking, she avoids basic attacks and skill damage taken is reduced. <color=white>Liquid Strength:</color> the damage dealt to an enemy hit from her next basic attack and damage from Dialed In are increased depending on her BAC.

skills.name: Bottom Shelf
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 10 Seconds Cooldown

Li Dailin spits out cheap liquor in a cone in front of her, slowing enemies hit. <color=yellow>Tipsy:</color> Consumes BAC to greatly reduce movement speed of hit enemies.

skills.name: Striking Tiger
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Li Dailin launches forward, immune to crowd control, suppressing the enemy hit while channeling and following it up with consecutive kicks. <color=yellow>Striking Tiger:</color> Consumes all BAC when triggered. Damage is increased depending on the amount of consumed BAC.

skills.name: Perfect Fit
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Yuki stores cufflinks as a resource. Upon damaging an enemy, he consumes a stored cufflink, dealing additional skill damage. Yuki fully recovers cufflinks when moving out of combat. Activating Button Up will refill all of his cufflinks.

skills.name: From Head to Toe
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 5 Seconds Cooldown

Yuki's next basic attack deals additional damage and reduces the movement speed of enemies. Consuming a cufflink stuns enemies.

skills.name: Button Up
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

<color=green>Passive:</color> reduces cooldown of Button Up whenever Yuki deals damage. Yuki straightens up his outfit and reduces the cooldown of Dashing Gentleman. While using Button Up, his damage taken is reduced. When Button Up is complete, he gains cufflinks.

skills.name: Dashing Gentleman
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 16 Seconds Cooldown

Yuki dashes in the targeted direction, dealing damage to the first enemy hit. Hitting an enemy reduces their attack speed, and reduces the cooldown of Dashing Gentleman.

skills.name: Coup de Grace
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 90 Seconds Cooldown

Yuki unsheaths his sword and slashes an area in front of him, dealing an initial damage to enemies and leaving a mark, reducing movement speed of enemies. The mark explodes after Yuki sheathes his sword, dealing true damage equal to a percent of the enemy's max HP.

skills.name: Three Calamities
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

When Hyejin hits an enemy 3 times with a skill, Three Calamities is activated, fearing them and dealing an additional skill damage. Feared enemies cannot receive Three Calamities again for a certain time.

skills.name: Charm of Despair
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 7 Seconds Cooldown

Hyejin casts a Charm of Despair in the targeted direction that goes through enemies, dealing damage to up to 2 enemies. Hitting an enemy reduces cooldown.

skills.name: Charm of the Prophecy
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

Hyejin summons a Charm of the Prophecy in the targeted location. Enemies in the area are slowed. Charm of the Prophecy triggers after a few seconds, dealing skill damage and dragging enemies to the center of the area.

skills.name: Charm of the Nomad
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 13 Seconds Cooldown

Hyejin casts a Charm of the Nomad in the targeted location, dealing damage to enemies in the path. Recast: Hyejin teleports to the location of Charm of the Nomad, dealing skill damage to enemies within the area.

skills.name: Five Omens
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Hyejin summons 5 Omens, dealing damage to nearby enemies. The Omens spin around Hyejin for a few seconds, each dealing skill damage to enemies hit. Omens are consumed after hitting an enemy. Hyejin is slowed while focusing on this skill.

skills.name: Juggernaut Chef
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Food prepared by Xiukai has bonus recovery. He gains a stack of Juggernaut Chef, increasing his max HP for each stack.

skills.name: Lost in the Sauce
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 6 Seconds Cooldown

Xiukai throws his sauce barrel in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage to enemies hit. The sauce barrel leaves sauce behind, reducing movement speed of enemies in the area.

skills.name: Eat Up!
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 4 Seconds Cooldown (16 Seconds Charging Time)

Xiukai throws food at a targeted ally or himself, recovering HP and increasing defense for a certain period of time.

skills.name: Wok It Off
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

<color=white>Wok It Off</color>: Xiukai slides on his wok toward the targeted location, hitting the first enemy he encounters. He deals skill damage to the enemy and nearby enemies hit, pushing them back slightly and sending them airborne. He can use <color=white>Heavy Meal</color> within a certain amount of time after using this skill. <color=white>Heavy Meal</color>: Xiukai slams his giant wok on the ground, dealing skill damage and slowing enemies in the area around him.

skills.name: Heavy Meal
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Xiukai slams his giant wok on the ground, dealing skill damage and slowing enemies in the area around him.

skills.name: Burnt to a Crisp
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Xiukai dishes out fire from his wok, dealing skill damage to enemies in a cone in front of him and reducing the target's healing and movement speed.

skills.name: Stigma
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

When Chiara hits an enemy with a skill, she carves a Stigma into them, reducing their healing. When Chiara moves toward the enemy at max Stigma stacks, her movement speed increases.

skills.name: Hand of Corruption
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 8 Seconds Cooldown

Chiara shoots out corrupted energy, dealing skill damage. Hitting with corrupted energy several times deals additional skill damage per hit, starting from the second hit. Chiara recovers HP over a certain amount of time when she hits an enemy.

skills.name: Depraved Prayer
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown

Chiara creates a shield that absorbs damage based on her lost HP. If the shield remains, she can reactivate the skill to make the shield explode. Enemies in range take skill damage from the explosion.

skills.name: Mania
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 15 Seconds Cooldown

Chiara sends out a shackle in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage to enemies hit and linking them to Chiara. If the link is maintained, she deals skill damage and roots the enemy.

skills.name: Plague
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 60 Seconds Cooldown

Chiara channels the darkness inside of her causing a Plague and transforming into a fallen angel. Her basic attack range and max HP increase. She consumes Plague gauge every second while she has transformed. Enemies nearby take skill damage, and Chiara recovers HP per target and recharges the Plague gauge. Chiara can perform Last Judgement during the Plague. <color=white>Last Judgement</color>: Chiara descends quickly upon her target, dealing true damage based on Stacks of Stigma. If she kills a Test Subject, the Plague resets and she can use Last Judgement again. After using Last Judgement, she becomes Untargetable while descending upon the target.

skills.name: Last Judgement
skills.tooltip: No Cost

skills.name: Agony
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 2 Seconds Cooldown

As Sissela's HP decreases, she gains HP Regen and Skill Amp. When Wilson returns to Sissela, her next basic attack deals additional skill damage and reduces the movement speed of enemies.

skills.name: Go Get 'Em Wilson!
skills.tooltip:
HP: 40 / 8 Seconds Cooldown

Wilson flies in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage to enemies in his path and skill damage to enemies in range upon arrival.

skills.name: Girl in a Bubble
skills.tooltip:
HP: 50 / 17 Seconds Cooldown

Wilson embraces Sissela, blocking all damage and increasing her movement speed. Wilson then explodes when used again or after some time, dealing skill damage to enemies in an area around her.

skills.name: Play With Us!
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 11 Seconds Cooldown

Wilson stretches his body in the targeted direction, pulling the first target hit towards Wilson. If Wilson hits Sissela, Sissela gains a shield, absorbing damage, and reduces this skill’s cooldown. If Wilson hits an enemy, the enemy receives damage and is stunned. If Go Get 'Em Wilson! is used during the pull, the target will also move towards Wilson’s moving direction.

skills.name: Free at Last
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 90 Seconds Cooldown

Sissela channels and deals skill damage to enemy test subjects nearby, including herself. She deals additional damage based on her missing HP. Sissela's HP will not drop below 100 when taking damage from this skill. Dealing damage with this skill momentarily increases the damage dealt from Agony.

skills.name: Lumia Grand Prix
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Upon entering a new area, excluding the Research Center, Silvia's Attack Speed is increased. If she visits 10 areas, her Skill Amp and Attack Speed are increased. She regains fuel when not on her bike.

skills.name: Radar Gun
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 6 Seconds Cooldown

<color=#ffd775>On foot:</color> Silvia fires a Radar Gun, dealing skill damage to enemies hit and healing allies hit. Silvia gains fuel for each target she hits. <color=#ffd775>On Bike:</color> Silvia spins on her bike, dealing skill damage to enemies in range.

skills.name: Finish Line
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

<color=#ffd775>On foot:</color> Silvia sets up a Finish Line in the targeted location, dealing skill damage and slowing enemies that pass through it. This can only occur once per enemy. Silvia gains fuel for each target she hits. <color=#ffd775>On Bike:</color> Silvia jumps in the direction she is currently facing, dealing skill damage to enemies in range and knocking them airborne.

skills.name: Spare Tire
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

<color=#ffd775>On foot:</color> Silvia launches a Spare Tire in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage based on the distance. Enemies in close range are knocked back. Silvia gains fuel when hitting enemies at long range. <color=#ffd775>On Bike:</color> Silvia wheelies toward the targeted enemy, dealing skill damage and knocking them back. She deals additional damage depending on her movement speed.

skills.name: Shift Gears
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 5 Seconds Cooldown

<color=#ffd775>On foot:</color> Silvia hops on her motorcycle, consuming fuel every second while on her bike, increasing her movement speed and her defense, and giving her different skills. Her movement speed is reduced until she warms up her motorcycle. She can Shift Gears when her fuel is above a certain amount. Silvia cannot use basic attacks or weapon skills while riding her motorcycle. <color=#ffd775>On Bike:</color> Silvia dismounts her bike and reverts her skills. Her next basic attack within a few seconds deals extra skill damage.

skills.name: Power Slide
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 3.5 Seconds Cooldown

Silvia spins on her bike, dealing damage to enemies in range.

skills.name: Front Flip
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 8 Seconds Cooldown

Silvia jumps in the direction she is currently facing, dealing damage to enemies in range and knocking them airborne.

skills.name: Wheelie
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown

Silvia wheelies toward the targeted enemy, dealing damage and knocking them back. She deals additional damage depending on her movement speed.

skills.name: Shift Gears
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 0.5 Seconds Cooldown

Silvia dismounts her bike and reverts her skills. Her next basic attack within a few seconds deals extra damage.

skills.name: Pyromaniac
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Enemies who take damage from a skill are Burned, losing defense and taking damage over time. Enemies who were already Burned, cannot catch on fire again for a fixed period of time.

skills.name: Flamethrower
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 4 Seconds Cooldown

Adriana throws flames in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage.

skills.name: Oil Slick
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 0.3 Seconds Cooldown (14 Seconds Charging Time)

Adriana spills oil on the targeted location. She can ignite the oil slick either with a skill or if a burning enemy walks over the oil, and start a fire that lasted for a certain period of time. Enemies inside the oil slick are slowed.

skills.name: Fire Escape
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 18 Seconds Cooldown

<color=green>Passive: </color> Adriana can start fires on the ground. Enemies inside a burning area take skill damage over time and are slowed. Adriana dashes in the targeted direction, leaving behind a trail of fire. The flames create fire and remain on the ground for a certain time.

skills.name: Cocktail Party
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 1 Seconds Cooldown (24 Seconds Charging Time)

Adriana throws a Molotov cocktail at the targeted location. The Molotov cocktail explodes upon landing, dealing skill damage. After the explosion, the Molotov cocktail leaves behind a fire. Adriana can hold a maximum of 3 Molotov cocktails.

skills.name: Phony Deal
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Shoichi earns stacks of Phony Deal each time he hits an enemy with a skill. Upon reaching max stacks, his next basic attack deals extra skill damage and a dagger falls behind them. If Shoichi picks the dagger up off the ground again, he throws it at the nearest enemy, dealing skill damage. The dagger is thrown first at Risky Business's targets.

skills.name: Good Faith
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 8 Seconds Cooldown

Shoichi lunges his blade in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage. Hitting an enemy reduces the cooldown and enables him to use Bad Faith. Bad Faith: increased range and Shoichi will leave a dagger on the ground.

skills.name: Bottom Line
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 16 Seconds Cooldown

Shoichi dashes to a targeted enemy or dagger, dealing skill damage to all enemies in his path. If he picks up a dagger, the cooldown of Bottom Line is reset.

skills.name: Risky Business
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 13 Seconds Cooldown

Shoichi takes a step back and throws a dagger to the front, dealing skill damage to enemies hit and slowing them. Enemies hit are marked with Risky Business and a dagger falls behind them. If marked enemies are hit with his dagger, taken damage increases. Every time an enemy marked with Risky Business is hit, cooldown is reduced. If they are killed, cooldown is reduced even more.

skills.name: Ruthless
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Shoichi swings his deadly briefcase, dealing skill damage to enemies around him, reducing their movement speed and tossing 4 daggers to the ground in a square. Daggers pierce enemies, dealing skill damage.

skills.name: CheerUP♥
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown

Every few seconds, Emma's basic attacks are enhanced, dealing additional skill damage and gaining a shield upon hit.

skills.name: Dove Dealer
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 5 Seconds Cooldown

Emma flings her card in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage to the first enemy and revealing her dove near her. If her dove is out when she flings another card, the dove magically transforms into a card and is also thrown in the targeted direction. Hitting an enemy with 1 card reduces the cooldown of Dove Dealer. Hitting an enemy with both cards slows them.

skills.name: Hat Trick
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 10 Seconds Cooldown

Emma tosses her hat in the targeted area. After some time, it explodes, dealing skill damage to enemies in the area. The hat vanishes after a few seconds. Hitting an enemy with Hat Trick reduces its cooldown.

skills.name: Bunnymorph
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

Emma casts magic at a targeted enemy, polymorphing them into a rabbit and dealing skill damage. Enemies turned into rabbits are slowed. The skill cannot be used on downed enemies.

skills.name: Change★
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 13 Seconds Cooldown

Magically teleport to a summoned dove, hat, or rabbit and use magic depending on the selected target. Dove: The dove flies towards Emma's last position, dealing skill damage to enemies on the way and rooting them. Hat: Emma switches places with the hat, dealing skill damage to enemies in the area while pulling them towards its center. Rabbit: Enemies in the area of the rabbit are also polymorphed and take skill damage. Enemies turned into rabbits are slowed and Emma's CheerUP♥ cooldown is reset.

skills.name: Bait and Tackle
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 16 Seconds Cooldown

Bait: Lenox gets extra items, excluding weapons, every time she fishes. Tackle: Every certain amount of time, dealing damage to enemy characters with basic attacks and skills grants Lenox a shield. Every time her skills deal damage to enemies, this skill's cooldown is reduced.

skills.name: Recoil
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 3 Seconds Cooldown

Lenox whips a circle area around her, dealing skill damage to enemies. She deals extra skill damage based on her max HP at the edge. Hitting an enemy grants her a stack, reducing the cooldown of Recoil per stack.

skills.name: Snakebite
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 16 Seconds Cooldown

Lenox whips twice, once in a circle around her, dealing skill damage and slowing enemies. Following that, she will send her whip flying, dealing skill damage and dragging enemies in front of her.

skills.name: Whiplash
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 9 Seconds Cooldown

Lenox sweeps her whip in an area around her, dealing skill damage and pushing or pulling enemies, depending on the direction of the skill. Enemies hit are slowed.

skills.name: Blue Viper
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Lenox quickly attacks twice in an X shape, dealing skill damage and applying Blue Viper. Blue Viper: For a certain amount of time, enemies take true damage depending on how far they move. Hitting an enemy with both attacks deals more true damage depending on how far they move.

skills.name: Dual Wield
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

After Rozzi uses a skill, her next basic attack within a few seconds triggers twice consecutively, dealing basic attack damage. Rozzi's attack power increases for a designated period of time when she consumes food made from chocolate.

skills.name: Easy Shot
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 5 Seconds Cooldown

Rozzi fires her pistols in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage to enemies hit. If she hits an enemy, she dashes on her next movement command within a few seconds and the cooldown of Easy Shot is reduced.

skills.name: Flutter
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 6 Seconds Cooldown

Rozzi unloads a barrage of bullets in an area around her, dealing skill damage to enemies in range, decreasing their defense for a few seconds and reducing their Healing Reduction. While Rozzi is shooting, her movement speed is increased. Cooldown is reduced if she hits any enemies.

skills.name: Gun Vault
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 18 Seconds Cooldown

Rozzi vaults over her target and shoots them, dealing skill damage and stunning them. While jumping, Rozzi becomes untargetable.

skills.name: Semtex Bomb Mk II
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 25 Seconds Cooldown

Rozzi launches a semtex bomb that explodes a few seconds after attaching to an enemy or the ground, dealing skill damage. Enemies with the bomb attached are slowed and share vision with Rozzi. Multiple basic attacks on the attached target will cause it to explode immediately, dealing damage based on the target's Max HP and slowing them. Attacking enemies with a skill while the bomb is attached counts as a few basic attacks. If Semtex bomb Mk-II explodes early, its cooldown is reduced and Rozzi's movement speed is increased.

skills.name: Neat 'n Tidy
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

If Luke deals damage to an enemy with a basic attack or a skill, his attack speed increases for a certain amount of time. <color=white>Neat:</color> Luke recovers some of his lost HP when he enemy character kill assists and when he kills Wickeline. <color=white>Tidy:</color> Luke gains a stack of <color=yellow>Tidy</color> upon killing enemy characters, wild animals or opening air supplies. Luke can use his Evolved skill by stacking <color=yellow>Tidy</color>.

skills.name: Clean Sweep
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 15 Seconds Cooldown

Luke throws a bottle of his favorite cleaning product in the targeted direction, dealing damage to enemies hit and granting him vision of them. He can recast this skill within a certain period of time. Recast: Luke dashes to the enemy hit, dealing skill damage depending on the target's Lost HP. <color=yellow>Evolved</color>: Dealing damage with the recast reduces the target's defense for a certain amount of time.

skills.name: Elbow Grease
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 10 Seconds Cooldown

Luke swings his cleaning tools, dealing skill damage and recovering some of his lost HP per target hit. <color=yellow>Evolved</color>: Basic attacking an enemy reduces <color=white>Elbow Grease</color>'s cooldown.

skills.name: Dirty Work
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

<color=green>Passive</color>: Luke’s attacks and kills do not trigger pings on the minimap. Active: Luke teleports behind a targeted enemy or a camera installed by him or his allies and fires a shot, dealing skill damage, disrupting enemies' focus and slowing them. When used on a camera, the skill range is increased and the camera's installation cooldown is triggered. <color=yellow>Evolved</color>: Targets are eliminated when he deals damage with <color=white>Dirty Work</color> to enemies with HP below a certain threshold. Enemy character kill assists trigger the cooldown of <color=white>Dirty Work</color> and camera installations.

skills.name: Pressure Washer
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

<color=green>Passive</color>: Every time Luke basic attacks enemies, he marks them. Dealing skill damage to marked targets, deals additional skill damage per stack and slows them. Luke jumps backward and uses his cleaning tool as an explosive, dealing skill damage based on lost HP to enemies within range and slowing them. <color=yellow>Evolved</color>: Luke gains vision of targets that take damage from <color=white>Pressure Washer</color> and significantly slows them.

skills.name: Under the Knife
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 16 Seconds Cooldown

When Cathy damages enemies with a skill, she applies Wounded, dealing damage over time. Upon reaching 3 stacks, Cathy Severely Wounds an enemy, dealing more damage for a longer duration and applying Healing Reduction. Severely Wounding enemies grants her a shield, absorbing damage for a few seconds. While shielded, her movement speed increases if she moves toward Wounded or Severely Wounded enemies, decaying over time.

skills.name: Double Bypass
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 15 Seconds Cooldown

<color=green>Passive</color>: After using a skill, Cathy's next basic attack deals skill damage instead. Cathy dashes in the targeted direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. The cooldown of Double Bypass is reduced if Cathy Severely Wounds an enemy.

skills.name: Amputation
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown

Cathy swings her saw in front of her. Enemies hit by the inner range take skill damage but do not receive stacks of Wounded. Enemies hit by the outer range take skill damage and are slowed for a few seconds.

skills.name: Suture
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 15 Seconds Cooldown

Cathy throws her suture thread, dealing skill damage to the first enemy hit and rooting them for a few seconds. Sutures can pass through the target and hit an extra enemy. Sutures that hit a second target push the initial target towards the second target, dealing additional skill damage and stunning them. Sutures that hit a wall push the enemy into the wall, dealing extra skill damage and stunning them. Damage from the suture does not apply stacks of Wounded.

skills.name: Emergency Surgery
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

<color=green>Passive</color>: If Cathy revives a downed ally, she creates a healing zone, recovering her ally's max HP per second for a few seconds. Cathy charges in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage based on the enemy's missing HP and causing Severe Wounds. Hitting a Severely Wounded enemy resets the duration. A healing zone is created where Cathy dashes, recovering her and her allies' HP. Becomes unstoppable while moving.

skills.name: Control the Center
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Adela's attack range is increased, her attack speed is fixed. If her Attack Speed increases, her Skill Amp increases too.

skills.name: Promotion
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 2.4 Seconds Cooldown Adela places her pawn at the targeted location, dealing skill damage. Placing a pawn grants her a stack. Upon reaching a certain amount of stacks, her movement speed increases. Her next pawn will be Queened, dealing skill damage and stunning enemies hit for a few seconds. Stacks are reset if Promotion is not reactivated within a few seconds. Pawns and Queens remain for a few seconds. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Knight Fork
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 3 Seconds Cooldown (17 Seconds Charging Time)

Adela moves her Knight to the targeted location, dealing skill damage. It hops, dealing skill damage upon landing. Hitting a pawn, queen, or rook with the initial landing spot pushes the piece opposite of the knight, causing different effects. Pawn and Queen: Piece stops upon hitting an enemy, dealing damage proportional to the damage dealt with Promotion, and knocking them airborne. Rook: deals damage proportional to the damage dealt with Castling to enemies hit, knocking them airborne. Knights remain for a few seconds. Summoning another Knight will cause the first Knight to dissappear.

skills.name: Castling
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown

Adela slides her rook in the targeted direction dealing skill damage to enemies hit. Hitting a pawn, queen or knight on the way causes those pieces to deal damage. Pawn and queen: deal damage proportional to the damage dealt with Promotion. Knight: deal damage proportional to the damage dealt with Knight Fork and slow enemies. Reactivate the skill within a few seconds to switch places with the rook. Rooks remain for a few seconds. Sliding another rook will cause the first rook to dissappear.

skills.name: Checkmate
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Adela raises into the air, becoming unable to take damage. Upon landing, she deals skill damage and additional damage based on enemy's max HP per active chess piece as true damage. All active chess pieces also attack, dealing a portion of their activation damage and disappearing.

skills.name: Buckshot
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Bernice fires multiple bullets with his basic attack. Bullets deal basic attack damage based on the number of hits on the enemy target. Bernice's basic attacks do not receive additional Critical Strike Damage. On a critical hit, instead of the normal critical strike effect, he fires another round of bullets dealing additional basic attack damage. Bernice has a faster reload time based on his ammo level.

skills.name: Leg Shot
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 7 Seconds Cooldown

Bernice fires an expanded projectile from his gun, dealing skill damage to enemies hit. Enemies hit are slowed. Rooted enemies take extra skill damage and are slowed.

skills.name: Foothold Trap
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 1 Seconds Cooldown (18 Seconds Charging Time)

Bernice sets a trap on the ground for a few seconds, dealing damage to enemies that step on them and rooting them. He can hold up multiple Foothold Trap charges and can set multiple traps at a time depending on the skill's level.

skills.name: Falconry
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 10 Seconds Cooldown

<color=green>Passive</color>: Bernice marks enemies that step on a Foothold Trap, granting him vision and increasing his movement speed when moving towards the marked target. Bernice's basic attacks on marked enemies reduce the cooldowns of Leg Shot and Explosive Bola. Active: Bernice's falcon hovers in the air, increasing his vision for a moment. The Falcon marks a nearby enemy for a few seconds.

skills.name: Explosive Bola
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 90 Seconds Cooldown

Bernice fires his bola bomb in a targeted direction, dealing damage to the first enemy hit and rooting them. After a few seconds, it explodes, dealing skill damage to the rooted enemy and spreading to the nearest enemy in range.

skills.name: Retrofit
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 9 Seconds Cooldown

<color=green>Passive:</color> Barbara, being the ingenious engineer that she is, reduces her equipment crafting time. Her basic attacks are enhanced periodically, dealing additional skill damage on-hit. Her enhanced basic attacks increase her attack speed.

skills.name: BT Sentry Gun Mk.II
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 16 Seconds Cooldown

Barbara installs a Sentry Gun in the targeted location. (Max: 2) The Sentry Gun remains for a certain amount of time. When she moves beyond a certain range or if she dies, her Sentry Gun disappears after a designated amount of time. If Barbara moves back within the area, the duration is reset. When her <color=white>Free-Electron Laser</color>, <color=white>Magnetic Explosion</color> hit an enemy or every 4th Sentry Gun attack, her railgun is fired and it charges up to 3 times. Every time her Sentry Gun deals damage to enemies, <color=white>Free-Electron Laser</color>'s cooldown is reduced.

skills.name: Enhanced - BT Sentry Gun Mk.III
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Barbara installs an Enhanced Sentry Gun in a targeted location. The enhanced Sentry Gun remains for certain amount of tim. When she moves beyond a certain distance or if she dies, her Sentry Gun disappears after a certain amount of time. If Barbara moves back within the area, the duration is reset. The Enhanced Sentry Gun applies the enhanced effect on the installed Sentry Gun, increasing attack speed and firing a railgun every certain amount of basic attacks.

skills.name: Free-Electron Laser
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 8 Seconds Cooldown

Barbara fires a powerful Free-Electron Laser, dealing skill damage to enemies in her path. Hitting enemies increases her movement speed for a certain amount of time.

skills.name: Ultra Free-Electron Laser
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Barbara fires an Ultra Free-Electron Laser at full power, dealing skill damage to enemies in her path and destroying cameras and traps. Enemies hit take skill damage over a certain amount of time. Hitting enemies increases her movement speed.

skills.name: Magnetic Explosion
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

Barbara creates a Magnetic Explosion, dealing skill damage. Enemies hit inside the area are stunned for a certain amount of time.

skills.name: Photon Explosion
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Barbara creates a Magnetic Explosion, dealing skill damage. Enemies hit inside the area are stunned for a certain amount of time. After the explosion a magnetic field remains, dealing consecutive skill damage to enemies within the field and slowing them.

skills.name: Overclock
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 65 Seconds Cooldown

Barbara's basic skills are enhanced. Reusing it cancels the enhancement and she can only recast after 3 seconds. <color=white>Enhanced - BT Sentry Gun Mk.III:</color> Barbara installs an Enhanced Sentry Gun. The enhanced Sentry Gun remains for a few seconds. There's no limit on the number of installations. The Enhanced Sentry Gun applies the enhanced effect on the installed Sentry Gun, increasing attack speed and firing a railgun every 3rd basic attack. P<color=white>Ultra Free-Electron Laser:</color> Barbara fires an Ultra Free-Electron Laser at full power, dealing skill damage to enemies in her path and destroying cameras and traps. Enemies hit take skill damage over time. <color=white>Photon Explosion:</color> Barbara creates an Enhanced Magnetic Explosion, dealing skill damage. Enemies hit inside the area are stunned for a certain amount of time. After the explosion a magnetic field remains, dealing consecutive skill damage to enemies within the field and slowing them.

skills.name: Infiltration
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Weapon Supply: Alex receives a weapon supply when he reaches certain levels. He infiltrates after getting a kill or assist. Enemies cannot see Alex when outside of his detection range. While infiltrating, his movement speed is increased if an enemy is within a certain range. His weapon mastery levels all increase equally. When equipped with a melee weapon, his defense is increased.

skills.name: Gauss Pistol
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 7 Seconds Cooldown

Alex fires his gauss pistol, dealing skill damage to enemies hit. If Gauss Pistol hits an enemy, Alex's attack power is increased for a certain amount of time. If he has maximum stacks of both Incursion and Gauss Pistol, his attack speed is increased.

skills.name: Recognition Signal
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 13 Seconds Cooldown

Alex launches a signal in the targeted area, dealing skill damage to enemies in range and granting him vision for a moment. Hitting an enemy temporarily increases his basic attack range.

skills.name: Blowback
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 13 Seconds Cooldown

<color=green>Passive</color>: Alex’s attack speed is increased. He throws an electric shuriken in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage and slowing enemies hit, steps backwards, and begins infiltrating. Infiltrating after using the skill allows Alex to swap weapons once. Ending infiltration or changing weapons cancels the effect.

skills.name: EMP Barrage
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 90 Seconds Cooldown

Alex calls in a strike at a targeted location, dealing skill damage to enemies in range and more damage to enemies in the center. Enemies hit are slowed. The missile then pulses several times, slowing enemies and dealing skill damage, dealing more damage to enemies in the center.

skills.name: Incursion
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 7 Seconds Cooldown

Alex charges towards his target, dealing damage. Hitting enemies increases his attack power for a moment. If he has maximum stacks of both Incursion and Gauss Pistol, his attack speed is increased.

skills.name: Dead Drop
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 11 Seconds Cooldown

Alex tosses his Dead Drop in a targeted location, dealing damage to enemies in range and pulling them to the center.

skills.name: Double Agent
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 13 Seconds Cooldown

<color=green>Passive</color>: Alex’s Attack Speed is increased. While the hologram remains, his passive is multiplied. Alex dashes in the targeted direction, infiltrating and leaving behind a hologram. The hologram taunts enemies in range, forcing them to attack it. After using the skill and infiltrating, he can swap his weapon. Ending infiltration or swapping weapons cancels the effect. Infiltration only occurs starting at level 6.

skills.name: Bookworm
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

After Sua uses a skill, her next basic attack deals extra damage and also damages targets in a range around the attack. She recovers a portion of damage dealt as HP. Having a stack of Bookworm increases her attack speed. Hitting an enemy reduces her basic skill cooldowns. If multiple enemies are hit, cooldown reduction is still applied only once. This basic attack is also considered as a skill.

skills.name: Odyssey
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown

Sua manifests two books in a targeted direction that collide at the center, dealing skill damage to enemies in range and leaving a bookmark on the enemy. Creating a new bookmark triggers the old one, dealing skill damage and stunning them. Damage to enemies hit in the center is increased, and their movement speed is reduced.

skills.name: The Curious Case
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 19 Seconds Cooldown

Self cast: Sua shields herself, absorbing skill damage and becoming immune to crowd control effects. Enemy cast: Sua's bird attacks the enemy, dealing skill damage and blinding them.

skills.name: Don Quixote
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 16 Seconds Cooldown

Sua manifests a lance and flies forward, dealing skill damage to the first enemy hit, applying a bookmark and slowing them. Enemies that have a bookmark take skill damage and are knocked airborne. If Sua hits with Don Quixote, she recovers some of her lost HP. Sua is immune to crowd control effects while her weapon is transforming.

skills.name: Memory
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 26 Seconds Cooldown

Sua remembers the last skill she used and can use it again with greater effect. <color=yellow>Odyssey</color>: Enemies hit by the book collision take skill damage and a bookmark is attached to enemies hit. Making a new bookmark triggers the old one, dealing skill damage and stunning enemies. Enemies at the site of the book collision are slowed. <color=yellow>Curious Case</color>: Self cast: Sua shields herself, absorbing skill damage and becoming immune to crowd control effects. Enemy cast: deals skill damage and blinds her enemy for a bit. <color=yellow>Don Quixote</color>: She deals damage to the first enemy hit, applying a bookmark and slowing them. Enemies that have a bookmark take skill damage and are knocked airborne. If Sua hits with Don Quixote, she recovers a certain amount of HP. Sua is immune to crowd control effects while her weapon is transforming.

skills.name: Memory of Odyssey
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 26 Seconds Cooldown

Sua manifests two books in a targeted direction that collide at the center, dealing skill damage to enemies in range and leaving a bookmark on the enemy. Creating a new bookmark triggers the old one, dealing skill damage and stunning them. Damage to enemies hit in the center is increased, and their movement speed is reduced.

skills.name: Memory of The Curious Case
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 26 Seconds Cooldown

Self cast: Sua shields herself, absorbing skill damage and becoming immune to crowd control effects. Enemy cast: Sua's bird attacks the enemy, dealing skill damage and blinding them.

skills.name: Memory of Don Quixote
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 26 Seconds Cooldown

Sua manifests a lance and flies forward, dealing skill damage to the first enemy hit, applying a bookmark and slowing them. Enemies that have a bookmark take skill damage and are knocked airborne. If Sua hits with Don Quixote, she recovers some of her lost HP. Sua is immune to crowd control effects while her weapon is transforming.

skills.name: Human Torpedo
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 8 Seconds Cooldown

Leon creates a pool whenever he performs a basic attack. Leon's movement speed and attack speed are increased when he's on top of one of his pools. Pool Shark: Leon's basic attacks deal additional skill damage when he stands in one of his pools.

skills.name: Waterway
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 11 Seconds Cooldown

Leon splashes water in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage to enemies hit and creating a water trace. Water traces have the same effects as water pools.

skills.name: Cannonball
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

Leon shields himself and nearby allies.

skills.name: Duck Dive
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 1.5 Seconds Cooldown (16 Seconds Charging Time)

Leon channels to instantly dive in the targeted location. He emerges out of his dive, dealing skill damage to enemies nearby and knocking them airborne. He becomes untargettable while diving, and a pool is created when he finishes his dive.

skills.name: Surf's Up
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Leon surfs on a wave, dealing skill damage to enemies in the way and knocking them back until the wave dissipates. Enemies knocked into terrain take skill damage and are knocked airborne.

skills.name: Ground Beef
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Eleven can prepare a #11 Combo Meal by combining Bread and Meat. Eleven drops sliders on the ground whenever she hits enemies with skills. She can step on a slider to recover HP. Enemies can step on sliders to destroy them.

skills.name: Burger Queen
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 5.5 Seconds Cooldown

Eleven slams down her massive burger, dealing damage proportional to her target's Max HP and slowing her enemies down. Her damage dealt and movement speed reduction depend on her channeling time.

skills.name: Food For Thought
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 15 Seconds Cooldown

Eleven raises her fork, taunting enemies around her and dealing damage. Her final damage taken is reduced while she's charging, and the effect continues for a certain period of time even after using the skill.

skills.name: On Air!
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 16 Seconds Cooldown

Eleven sticks her fork in the ground and flings herself through the air to a targeted location, dealing damage and knocking enemies back. Her movement range and damage dealt depend on her channeling time.

skills.name: Calorie Cyclone
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Eleven continuously recovers HP and deals consecutive damage to her enemies nearby for a short period of time.

skills.name: Hassetsu
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Rio's basic attacks and skills ignore some of her enemies' defense based on her critical strike chance. Rio's basic attacks can't critically strike but deal increased damage. Her basic attack damage is increased based on her critical strike chance.

skills.name: Kyudo Instinct
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 0.8 Seconds Cooldown Passive: Basic attacks or skills grant her a stack of Flow. Upon reaching a certain number of stacks, dealing damage with Rio's next basic attack triggers an effect depending on her current bow. Hankyu: Rio's movement speed and attack speed is increased for a short time. Daikyu: Rio's basic attacks deal more damage based on her target's missing HP and the range of Rio's next basic attack is increased. Toggle: Rio switches between her Hankyu and Daikyu Hankyu: Multiple additional arrows are fired with each basic attack, dealing extra basic attack damage with each arrow. Daikyu: 1 powerful arrow is fired with each basic attack. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Hanare
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 6 Seconds Cooldown

<color=white>Hanare</color> on hit reduces Rio's skill cooldown. Hankyu: Rio fires arrows in a cone shape, dealing skill damage to enemies in range. A breeze is created at the site where targets were hit, slowing them. Daikyu: Rio fires a single arrow in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage to enemies hit and to enemies behind the target in a cone shape. Damaged targets are slowed.

skills.name: Soar
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 16 Seconds Cooldown

Hankyu: Rio lunges into the targeted direction, firing multiple arrows at enemies in range and dealing skill damage. Hitting an enemy gives the max amount of Stacks for Hassetsu. Daikyu: Rio jumps into the targeted direction, firing 1 arrow at enemies in range, dealing skill damage to them and around the target. Hitting an enemy gives the max amount of Stacks for Hassetsu.

skills.name: Fleeting Soul / Spirit Arrow
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Casting <color=white>Fleeting Soul / Spirit Arrow</color> grants the maximum stacks of Flow. Hankyu: Rio fires arrows in the targeted direction, each dealing skill damage, knocking back, and reducing the cooldown of Fleeting Soul/Spirit Arrow. After firing consecutive arrows, she fires an extra arrow, dealing skill damage and knocking enemies back. Enemies knocked into a wall are stunned and take skill damage. Daikyu: Rio channels and fires an arrow in the targeted direction, dealing skill range damage to enemies hit and slowing them. After firing, the arrow's speed and damage increases, as well as its slow duration. The arrow disappears when it collides with the target or flies to the end of the range.

skills.name: No Hitter
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 1.5 Seconds Cooldown

William's basic attacks bounce a ball off his enemy and remain on the ground. Picking up a baseball causes his next basic attack within a certain amount of time to increase his range and deal extra damage. No Hitters stack after being picked up.

skills.name: Fastball
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 5 Seconds Cooldown

<color=green>Passive</color>: Fastball can only be used when No Hitter is fully stacked. William's attack speed is increased for a bit and he throws an additional baseball, dealing extra damage. Upon picking up a baseball, extra damage from No Hitter only applies to the first ball and the duration of Fastball is increased.

skills.name: Windup
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

William pitches in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage and slowing enemies. The ball returns to William, dealing the same damage and slow effects on its way back and granting him a No Hitter stack. Targets hit by the ball both on the way out and on the way back are stunned. <color=green>Mound</color>: William creates a mound, knocking enemies back. While standing on mound, No Hitter balls return to the spot and his defense is increased.

skills.name: Sliding Catch
skills.tooltip: No Cost Passive: His movement speed is increased when walking towards a baseball. William slides to the targeted baseball. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Signature Fireball
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 60 Seconds Cooldown

William leaps into the air and throws his signature fireball to the targeted area, dealing skill damage and slowing enemies. Enemies in the center are slowed more. Four balls bounce from the center after impact and remain on the ground.

skills.name: Short Tempered
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Nicky converts damage taken by other characters into Rage. Rage slowly decreases in a non-combat state. When her Rage Meter is full, she becomes Enraged. If she hits an enemy with a basic attack or skill while Enraged, the duration is reset. While she's Enraged, her attack speed increases and she basic atttacks, dealing additional skill damage to enemies around her.

skills.name: Slugfest
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

<color=#ffffff>Slugfest</color>: Nicky puts her full strength into a punch. Reactivate the skill to let loose, knocking back the first enemy hit and dealing damage. Distance and damage dealt is increased based on how long she charges. If Nicky hits an enemy, cooldown is reduced and she can land a Body Blow. <color=#ffffff>Body Blow</color>: Deals damage to enemies in front of her and gains Rage for each enemy hit.

skills.name: Body Blow
skills.tooltip: No Cost

skills.name: Guard & Reverse
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 8 Seconds Cooldown

<color=#ffffff>Guard</color>: Nicky guards, reducing damage taken and becoming immune to crowd control. Successful Guards allow her to use <color=white>Fury Jab!!</color>, once it ends, <color=white>Reverse</color> is activated. <color=#ffffff>Reverse</color>: Nicky rushes forward while maintaining reduced damage taken, dealing damage to enemies and slowing them.

skills.name: Knockout Punch
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown

<color=#ffffff>Knockout Punch</color>: Nicky throws a knockout punch in front of her, dealing damage and slowing enemies. <color=#ffffff>Fury Jab!!</color>: Successful Guards allow her to use Fury Jab!!, dealing even more damage to enemies in front of her, slowing and stunning them. <color=#ffffff>Fury Jab!!</color> does not share a cooldown with <color=#ffffff>Knockout Punch</color>.

skills.name: Fury Jab!!
skills.tooltip: No Cost

skills.name: Pure Rage Uppercut!!
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Nicky dashes towards her targeted enemy character while being unstoppable and uppercuts them, dealing skill damage and knocking them airborne. Her damage is increased when she gets Enraged while being Short Tempered.

skills.name: Slow Shutter
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Nathapon captures every moment he can on camera. His attack speed is fixed but his basic attacks deal additional skill damage. Nathapon's basic attacks can not deal critical strikes. <color=green>Picturesque</color> Dealing skill or basic attack damage to an enemy grants a stack of Picturesque. Picturesque can stack up to {3} times, and each stack increases Nathapon's skill damage. Combining <color=#35CB38>Telephoto Camera</color> and <color=#D6D6D6>Branch</color> will create a <color=#35CB38>Trail Camera</color> with Infiltration effects.

skills.name: Snapshot
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 5 Seconds Cooldown

Nathapon snaps a photograph at the targeted area, dealing skill damage. Enemies with max stacks of <color=white>Picturesque</color> have their attack speed and movement speed reduced for a short duration.

skills.name: Timelapse
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

Nathapon takes a Timelapse, dealing skill damage to enemies per second in range. Enemies in the Timelapse are slowed. The final photograph deals extra damage and roots subjects in frame.

skills.name: Panorama
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown

Nathapon takes a photo with his telephoto lens in the targeted direction. Photographed enemies take skill damage and are slowed. If the photo lands, it will leave a mark in that area. After a few seconds, Nathapon's next basic attack deals extra skill damage to the photographed enemy and knocks them back towards the mark. Nathapon's Attack Range is increased and Slow Shutter's extra damage is applied when attacking the enemy in the Panorama. The mark disappears when the enemy is knocked back or moves away from the mark.

skills.name: F-Stop
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Nathapon snaps a photo of everything in the targeted area. All photographed enemies are put into stasis and are unable to perform any action. Photographed enemies gain full stacks of Picturesque.

skills.name: Unyielding
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Jan gains a stack of Unyielding each time he deals damage. When he has some stacks of Unyielding, his next basic skill consumes stacks, enhancing it, and reducing the cooldown of his basic skills.

skills.name: Knee Strike
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown

Jan's attacks with a knee strike, dealing damage to enemies in range and slowing them. Reactivate to use Leaping Knee. Enhanced Knee Strike: Reduces enemy's defense. Leaping Knee: Jan launches a flying knee strike, dealing damage to enemies and knocking them airborne. Enhanced Leaping Knee: Hitting an enemy will reset the cooldown of Bob and Weave.

skills.name: Leaping Knee
skills.tooltip: No Cost

skills.name: Tomahawk Roundhouse
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 15 Seconds Cooldown

Jan sweeps the area in front of him with a kick, dealing skill damage to enemies in range. Enemies hit in the outer cone are knocked back. Enemies knocked into walls take additional skill damage and are stunned. Enhanced: Deals more damage and knocks back all enemies in range. Enemies knocked into walls take additional skill damage and are stunned.

skills.name: Bob and Weave
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 10 Seconds Cooldown

Jan dashes forward and causes his next basic attack to deal extra skill damage. Hitting Knee Strike or Tomahawk Roundhouse after dashing heals him for a percentage of damage dealt, increasing based on his missing HP. Jan can Bob and Weave while using Tomahawk Roundhouse. Enhanced: The cooldown of Bob and Weave is reduced.

skills.name: The Tetragon
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 70 Seconds Cooldown

Jan summons a square ring, granting him stacks of Unyielding. Enemies that touch the ropes are slowed and take damage. Enemies that are knocked back into the ropes are then knocked back towards the center of the ring. Ropes disappear upon contact. Enemy character kill assists inside the ring grant Unyielding stacks and increase Jan's movement speed.

skills.name: Telekinesis
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 5 Seconds Cooldown

Telekinesis: Starting at level 6, Eva can open item and air supply boxes, fish, collect, and recover downed allies in range. She can only revive, loot corpses and carcasses, or collect air supply boxes, Meteorite and Tree of Life in range during combat. VF Bead: When Eva lands a skill or is hit by a basic attack, Eva expels a bead of concentrated VF energy towards the enemy, dealing damage and slowing targets hit. Landing a VF Bead on an enemy reduces its cooldown and grants Vital Force. Eva gains Vital Force constantly when out of combat, and receives a bonus for kills and assists. Enhanced Basic Attacks grant Vital Force.

skills.name: Light Triad
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 9 Seconds Cooldown

Eva casts an orb of light in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage to enemies it hits. When the orb reaches maximum range or the skill is reactivated, it explodes dealing skill damage. If the explosion hits an enemy, cooldown is reduced. Hitting an enemy with Light Triad grants Vital Force.

skills.name: Phase Vortex
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 11 Seconds Cooldown

Eva forms a Phase Vortex in the targeted location, dealing skill damage. Enemies inside the vortex are slowed. The vortex collapses after a few seconds, dealing skill damage and launching enemies in the middle airborne. Hitting an enemy with Phase Vortex grants Vital Force.

skills.name: Amethyst Flow
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 9 Seconds Cooldown

Eva becomes immune to slow effects for a moment. Her movement speed is increased and she cannot do anything but move. She gains Vital Force and vision regardless of the terrain. If she deals skill damage on a target while this effect is active, her VF Light fires for a certain period of time, dealing skill damage. VF Light is not triggered on targets damaged with basic damage from <color=white>VF Eruption</color>, but on targets damaged by stack damage.

skills.name: VF Eruption
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Eva releases her stored VF, dealing skill damage and applying a stack of VF Dissonance to enemies in range. Upon reaching max stacks, Eva consumes the stacks, dealing damage. A minimum of 20 Vital Force is required to use VF Eruption. VF Eruption consumes Vital Force while channeling.

skills.name: Recluse
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Daniel thrives in the darkness. At night, his night vision and movement speed increase.

skills.name: Dusk Shears
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 10 Seconds Cooldown

Daniel manifests ghastly scissors in the targeted location, dealing damage to enemies hit. Hitting an enemy increases the attack speed of his next 3 basic attacks. Hitting an enemy with the middle of the blades deals more skill damage and slows enemies hit.

skills.name: Inspiration
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 7 Seconds Cooldown

Daniel marks the targeted enemy character with <color=#ffffff>Growing Inspiration</color>, granting him 2m of vision around his target. The <color=#ffffff>Growing Inspiration</color> mark reduces the target's vision range until attacked by Daniel, and stores some of Daniel's damage dealt to the target. Marked enemies become a <color=#ffffff>Target of Inspiration</color>. When Daniel attacks a <color=#ffffff>Target of Inspiration</color>, the mark explodes, dealing true damage equal to the stored damage along with skill damage. Enemies hit are also slowed. This skill can be used on any Boss Monsters.

skills.name: Shadow Glide
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 11 Seconds Cooldown

Daniel dashes to the front becoming invisible and ducks into the shadows. His next basic attack has extra range and teleports him to the opposite side of the target, dealing additional skill damage.

skills.name: Masterpiece
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 70 Seconds Cooldown

If Daniel deals damage to an enemy, he can become their shadow, silencing them. While Daniel is shadowing his target, he deals skill damage up to 4 times. Upon reaching the max duration or reactivating the skill, Daniel completes his masterpiece and leaves them behind in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage.

skills.name: Play Dead
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 70 Seconds Cooldown

<color=#ffffff>Rehearsal</color>: Every time Jenny performs a Basic Attack, <color=#ffffff>Persona (E)</color> cooldown is reduced. Taking on a new role using <color=#ffffff>Persona (E)</color> temporarily grants her extra effects. Her <color=yellow>Red Wine</color> role increases her attack speed, while her <color=yellow>Black Tea</color> role increases her movement speed. <color=#ffffff>Play Dead</color>: If Jenny's HP drops to 0, she feigns death, slowing her, but making her invisible, invincible, and untargetable. Jenny then ends her act, reviving and recovering HP.

skills.name: Spotlight
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 9 Seconds Cooldown

Jenny shines a spotlight in the targeted location 3 times, dealing damage. If the spotlight is shone on Jenny, skill cooldown is reduced, and she gains bonus stats based on her active role. Her attack speed is increased if she is in her <color=yellow>Red Wine</color> role, and her movement speed is increased if she is in her <color=yellow>Black Tea</color> role.

skills.name: Red Carpet
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 15 Seconds Cooldown

Jenny rolls out the red carpet in the targeted direction, dealing damage and slowing enemies. Reactivate Red Carpet to deal damage to all enemies on the carpet. The Red Carpet has additional effects based on her active role. <color=yellow>Red Wine</color>: Pulls in enemies standing on the carpet. <color=yellow>Black Tea</color>: Pushes away enemies standing on the carpet.

skills.name: Persona
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 13 Seconds Cooldown Passive: Jenny deals extra skill damage every 3rd basic attack or when activating this skill. Jenny dashes in the targeted direction and takes on a new role. Effects for existing Spotlights and Red Carpets are unaffected. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Acceptance Speech
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Jenny creates an award stage around her, slowing enemies and resetting the cooldown of <color=#ffffff>Persona</color>. The stage implodes after a few seconds, dealing skill damage and charming enemies inside

skills.name: Olé!
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 20 Seconds Cooldown

Damaging an enemy grants Camilo a shield absorbing damage, and increases his attack speed. Chaining alternating basic attacks and skills reduces the cooldown of Olé! and Cierre.

skills.name: Vuelta
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 5 Seconds Cooldown

Camilo sweeps the area in front of him with his swords, dealing basic attack damage. Hitting an enemy with the outer range grants Camilo 1 stack of Paso, increasing his movement speed. Upon reaching 2 stacks, Camilo can use Enhanced Vuelta, causing him to spin twice, dealing basic attack damage around him, pulling nearby enemies inward, and healing himself. Vuelta only gains cooldown reduction based on Camilo's extra attack speed. When using Vuelta during Al Compás’s initial dash, Camilo damages enemies in a circle around him and gains Paso effects from hitting enemies with the edge.

skills.name: Cierre
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 18 Seconds Cooldown

Camilo elegantly dashes forward with his swords, dealing basic attack damage.

skills.name: Al Compás
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Camilo quickly steps to his target, dealing skill damage and applying One Step. Camilo can recast Al Compás to dash to the target again, dealing skill damage, knocking them back, and applying Two Step while gracefully stepping away. Camilo can not use Al Compás on a target with Two Step.

skills.name: Duende
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Camilo twirls forward and returns to his starting point, greatly increasing his movement speed for a short duration. While twirling, Camilo is immune to crowd control and takes reduced damage. Upon returning, Camilo deals skill damage to enemies hit once. Hitting an enemy twice deals even more skill damage, stunning them. He also recovers HP for each enemy hit by his dance. Camilo can reuse Duende up to 2 times.

skills.name: Living Marionette
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Chloe is accompanied by her doll Nina, and can control her through <color=#f2f5a9>[Alt] + [Right Click]</color>. Enemies or locations can be targeted, and Nina will also follow Chloe around if Chloe is targeted. If Nina moves too far away from Chloe, she is teleported back near Chloe. Upon Nina’s health reaching 0, she will fall back and revive after some time. Nina gains extra stats based on Chloe’s passive level, and will also gain stats based on Chloe’s Attack Power, Defense, HP etc.

skills.name: Nina on Command
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 5 Seconds Cooldown

Following Chloe's command, Nina attacks with her bladed legs, dealing damage and slowing enemies.

skills.name: Puppet Theatre
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 15 Seconds Cooldown

Chloe twirls her bladed threads around her, dealing true damage per second to enemies and slowing them. Chloe can cast Nina on Command and Seam Ripper while twirling her threads Recast the skill to throw the threads in the targeted location, dealing damage to enemies and slowing them. After impact, Nina teleports to the location, dealing damage to enemies and knocking them airborne. After Nina teleports, the threads can be picked up, increasing Chloe’s movement speed.

skills.name: Seam Ripper
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

Chloe slides to the targeted direction, dealing damage to enemies in her path. Recasting the skill causes Nina to slide towards Chloe's location, dealing damage to enemies in her path. Hitting an enemy resets the cooldown of Nina on Command.

skills.name: Soul Link
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Chloe and Nina link their souls together. Upon linking, Nina’s Attack Speed and Movement Speed is increased, and the remaining cooldowns of Puppet Theatre and Seam Ripper are reduced. The Soul Link chain deals true damage to enemies touching it. If Chloe or Nina are damaged while linked, they take a partial amount of the damage and the linked partner also takes a part of the damage. While Soul Linked, Chloe and Nina cannot die unless they are both simultaneously fully depleted of health.

skills.name: Light's Blessing
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Johann has increased tenacity. Allies who have been healed or shielded by Johann's skills also gain tenacity.

skills.name: Radiant Brilliance
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown

Johann casts holy light in a targeted direction, healing allies on the way. When the light reaches the max distance or if the skill is reused, the light bursts, dealing skill damage. When the light touches <color=white>Transcendent Censer (W)</color>, it becomes enhanced, healing allies even more and rooting enemies upon bursting.

skills.name: Transcendent Censer
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 10 Seconds Cooldown

Johann sets his <color=white>Transcendent Censer</color> at the targeted location. While inside the smoke, enemies are slowed and allies gain attack speed and weapon mastery. Transcendent Censers can be moved once.

skills.name: Divine Scripture
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 20 Seconds Cooldown

Johann blesses an ally with <color=white>Divine Scripture</color>, removing all slows. The blessed target's movement speed is increased. The blessing deals skill damage to nearby enemies upon expiration. When <color=white>Transcendent Censer</color> touches a target blessed with Divine Scripture, the skill is enhanced, granting a shield and increasing damage dealt. Allies' movement speed is increased when moving towards a target blessed with Divine Scripture.

skills.name: Faith Unwavering
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 90 Seconds Cooldown

Johann consecrates the area around him, pushing away nearby enemies, dealing skill damage, and healing allies. Johann channels Faith Unwavering, increasing the defense of allies in range and healing them. Johann can move during the duration.

skills.name: Bloodletting
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 9 Seconds Cooldown

<color=white>Hemostasis</color> Every few seconds, Bianca’s next basic attack deals skill damage, slowing enemies. <color=white>Blood Bank</color> Bianca stores an amount of her skill damage dealt and her HP lost as <color=white>Blood</color>. When out of combat, Bianca consumes <color=white>Blood</color> to heal for the amount consumed.

skills.name: Sanguine Javelin
skills.tooltip:
Current HP 4% / 10 Seconds Cooldown

Bianca throws her Sanguine Javelin to the targeted direction, dealing skill damage to enemies hit. The javelin forms a blood pool on arrival, dealing damage to the first enemy that touches it. Enemies with <color=white>Hemostasis</color> are rooted when hit by <color=white>Sanguine Javelin</color>.

skills.name: Sanctuary
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

<color=green>Passive</color>: If Bianca's Blood is over 50%, the cooldown of <color=white>Sanctuary</color> is instantly reset. Bianca confines herself in her gothic coffin. While inside the coffin, Bianca takes reduced damage and continuosly heals. If Bianca has over 50% <color=white>Blood</color> when using <color=white>Sanctuary</color>, she instantly consumes all her stored <color=white>Blood</color>, increasing her healing inside the coffin based on the amount consumed and reducing the cooldown of all her skills, excluding <color=white>Sanctuary</color> and weapon skills, every few seconds. Bianca can use <color=white>Reign of the Vampire Queen</color> and <color=white>Circulation</color> while in her coffin, hiding the skill effects from enemies.

skills.name: Circulation
skills.tooltip:
Current HP 2% / 12 Seconds Cooldown

Bianca circulates blood around her and dashes, dealing skill damage. The circulation can be charged, consuming her HP, dealing extra damage and increasing the damage radius and dash range. If fully charged, hitting an enemy heals Bianca per enemy hit.

skills.name: Reign of the Vampire Queen
skills.tooltip:
Current HP 8% / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Bianca conjures a vampiric spell in a circle around her. After the incantation is complete, the circle sticks to the ground, dealing skill damage to enemies in range and slowing them. Bianca gains Omnisyphon while on the circle. The spell then explodes, dealing skill damage to enemies in range based on their missing HP, and heals Bianca per enemy hit. Bianca can use <color=white>Circulation</color> while conjuring the spell.

skills.name: Explosives Engineer
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

After 3 skills, Celine's next basic attack deals an additional skill damage. Instead of being affected by Cooldown Reduction stats, they are replaced by Skill Amp.

skills.name: Plasma Bomb
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 7 Seconds Cooldown Celine throws a Plasma Bomb and places it at a targeted location. If Celine Detonates her Plasma Bombs, she deals skill damage to those in range.
