Exploded or expired bombs become empty shells, and can be used with her Magnetic Compulsion skill. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Detonate
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 0.1 Seconds Cooldown Celine detonates the placed Plasma Bomb or Magnetic Compulsive explosive. If an enemy is hit by the explosion, Plasma Bomb cooldown is reduced per each connected/fused bomb. If Plasma Bomb was used, damage increases depending on the number of connected bombs. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Blast Wave
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown Celine tosses a shockwave ordnance at the target location, knocking away enemies and herself, and dealing skill damage. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Magnetic Compulsion
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 1.25 Seconds Cooldown Celine fuses together all of her Plasma Bombs and empty bombs to create a Magnetic Compulsion explosive. The fused bombs increase your Magnetic Compulsion up to Level 4. Damage and cooldown increase based on the number of Magnetic Compulsion explosives, and additional effects are applied. If she reaches 4 fused bombs, hit enemies are slowed. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Call of Cadmus
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Echion cannot equip or unequip weapons. When leveling up Call of Cadmus, Echion becomes uncontrollable for 1 second as he enhances his weapon.

skills.name: Crescent Viper
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 6 Seconds Cooldown

Echion launches a pulse of focused VF from his arm, dealing skill damage. If Echion damages an enemy, he can use Crescent Viper again. Recast: Echion launches a wider pulse, dealing skill damage and slowing enemies hit. Crescent Viper's range is drastically reduced during Exuviation.

skills.name: Keeled Scales
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 10 Seconds Cooldown

Echion consumes an amount of his stored VF to create a barrier around him, absorbing damage. Shield strength is increased based on the amount of VF consumed. If the shield absorbs damage to a certain amount, a percentage of the consumed VF is restored.

skills.name: Dry Bite
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 16 Seconds Cooldown

Echion dashes in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage and marking the first target hit. Hitting an unmarked enemy resets the cooldown of Dry Bite.

skills.name: VF Overflow [Viper]
skills.tooltip: No Cost Passive: Echion’s VF Gauge and his skill damage dealt proportional to his VF Gauge increase when he uses Crescent Viper(Q) and Dry Bite(E). When his VF Gauge is full he enters a VF Overflow state for a period of time and his increased damage is applied to the max. VF Overflow: Echion’s movement speed is increased and he periodically deals true damage to enemies nearby, activating Envenomization(R) and resetting the cooldown of Dry Bite(E). While VF Overflow is active, killing an enemy increases the duration of Overflow and Dry Bite(E)'s cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds. Exuviation: When Overflow ends, he enters Exuviation for a period of time, reducing his attack range and disabling VF Gauge increase. Envenomization(R): Echion fires unstable VF in a targeted direction, dealing skill damage. The duration of Overflow increases when he deals damage to enemy characters with Envenomization. Dealing damage with basic attacks reduces the cooldown of Envenomization. Envenomization’s effects change based on currently used weapon. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Envenomization [Viper]
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 3.5 Seconds Cooldown

Echion fires unstable VF in a targeted direction, dealing skill damage. The duration of Overflow increases when he deals damage to enemy characters with Envenomization. Dealing damage with basic attacks reduces the cooldown of Envenomization.

skills.name: Haute Couture
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Mai's basic attacks deal additional skill damage proportional to her additional HP. Mai is able to enhance her and her allies' legendary or higher chest armor. She can right click to do it for her allies.

skills.name: Drape
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 5 Seconds Cooldown

Mai whips her shawl, dealing skill damage to enemies in range. The targets of Mai's Pins are slowed when they are hit by her <color=white>Drape</color> again.

skills.name: Shawl Veil
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 4 Seconds Cooldown (26 Seconds Charging Time)

Mai veils herself with her shawl. While veiled, her damage taken is reduced and her movement speed gradually increases. The veil then explodes, dealing skill damage to enemies in range. Mai can hold up to 2 charges and has a short cooldown between casts. Basic attacks reduce the recharge cooldown.

skills.name: Catwalk
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 17 Seconds Cooldown

Mai dashes to a designated enemy character, wild animal, or camera. Using the skill on targets other than cameras grants her a shield. Ally targets gain the same amount of shield as her. She can recast the skill within a certain amount of time. <color=white>Strut</color>: Mai dashes in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage to enemies in her way and taunting them. On enemy hit, Mai's attack speed is increased.

skills.name: Strut
skills.tooltip: No Cost

skills.name: Exclusive
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 90 Seconds Cooldown

Mai entangles herself or a targeted ally with her shawl, making them invincible and suppressed. When they are released, they are healed and the effects of <color=white>Shaw Veil</color> activate when casting on herself. Casting on an ally pulls them towards Mai.

skills.name: Overcharge
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Aiden gains an <color=white>Ampere</color> for each enemy hit by his skills. When Aiden has enough <color=white>Amperes</color>, if there are no enemies nearby or he uses <color=white>Backstep</color>, he becomes <color=white>Overcharged</color> for {4} seconds. At this time, <color=white>Amperes</color> is switched to <color=white>Bullets</color> and the basic attack is changed to a long-range attack. While <color=white>Overcharged</color>, Aiden’s gains critical strike damage for every 1% of his critical strike chance and his basic attacks always critically strike, but he loses attack speed and critical strike damage. After <color=white>Overcharge</color> expires, Aiden's movement speed is increased for a few seconds.

skills.name: Lightning Strike
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 5 Seconds Cooldown Lightning Strike: Aiden thrusts his gunblade forward, dealing basic attack damage and gaining Amperes. Basic attacks reduce the cooldown of Lightning Strike. During Overcharge, Aiden changes to Volt Cannon. Volt Cannon: Aiden fires an electric bullet in the targeted direction, dealing basic attack damage to the first enemy hit and slowing them. Dealing damage to an enemy decreases Volt Cannon's cooldown. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Volt Cannon
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 5 Seconds Cooldown

skills.name: Dissipation
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 15 Seconds Cooldown

Aiden slows himself while he channels high voltage into his gunblade. When recast, or at max duration, Aiden deals skill damage to enemies nearby based on charge time and slows them. If fully charged, Aiden leaves behind a <color=white>Sparkring</color>, dealing skill damage to enemies that touch it and rooting them.

skills.name: Backstep
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 16 Seconds Cooldown

<color=green>Passive</color>: The cooldown of this skill is reset upon reaching full<color=white>Amperes</color>. <color=white>Backstep</color>: Aiden steps back and fires an electric bullet, dealing skill damage to the first enemy hit and marking them. The mark provides vision to Aiden and enables him to use<color=white>Bolt Rush</color>. Aiden’s movement speed is increased after using <color=white>Backstep</color>. <color=white>Bolt Rush</color>: Aiden dashes to the marked enemy, dealing skill damage.

skills.name: Bolt Rush
skills.tooltip: No Cost

skills.name: Electrostatic Surge
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Aiden discharges a thunderbolt at the targeted location, dealing skill damage and slowing enemies. Enemies hit in the middle receive skill damage and are stunned. Aiden then discharges a second thunderbolt at the same location, dealing skill damage and slowing enemies hit. Before the second thunderbolt strikes, Aiden can recast <color=white>Electrostatic Surge</color> to teleport to the thunderbolt’s location, immediately triggering the second thunderbolt. If the first thunderbolt hits an enemy test subject, Aiden’s <color=white>Amperes</color> are fully charged.

skills.name: Phantom Thief
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

After Laura uses her skill, her next basic attack's speed increases and she deals skill damage in a cone to targets nearby.

skills.name: Thorn Lilac
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 4 Seconds Cooldown

Laura snaps her whip once in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage. Hitting an enemy with the skill, allows her to reuse it. Reuse: Laura shortly dashes in the targeted direction.

skills.name: Calling Card
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 10 Seconds Cooldown

Laura throws her signature calling card in the targeted direction. Enemies hit by the card take skill damage and are slowed, becoming her <color=white>Victim</color> for a certain amount of time. Laura recovers HP every time she deals damage basic attacks or separate skills to enemies marked by <color=white>Victim</color>.

skills.name: Sly Step
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 19 Seconds Cooldown

Laura tosses her whip in the targeted direction. If her whip hits a wall, she ropes herself towards it. She can reuse this skill. Reuse: She leaps towards her targeted location, dealing skill damage to enemies nearby and knocking them airbone upon landing.

skills.name: Twilight Heist
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Laura gracefully deals skill damage to enemy characters nearby and pulls them forward. Hitting an enemy character grants her a shield and moments after she deals damage to enemies nearby. Her shield increases per additional enemy character she hits.

skills.name: Color Mixing
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

If Tia colors her enemy with two different colors using either <color=#ffffff>Brush Stroke</color> or <color=#ffffff>A Dash of Color</color>, <color=#FFFFC2>Chipmunk effect</color> is activated. Her basic skills are not affected by cooldown reduction effects. Instead, her Skill Amp is increased based on her cooldown reduction. [Mad Chipmunk] Painting an enemy with <color=#ffffff>Red and Yellow</color> activates Mad Chipmunk, silencing them and dealing skill damage. [Blessed Chipmunk] Painting an enemy with <color=#ffffff>Red and Blue</color> activates Blessed Chipmunk, dealing skill damage, healing Tia, and increasing her movement speed. [Magic Chipmunk] Painting an enemy with <color=#ffffff>Blue and Yellow</color> activates Magic Chipmunk, dealing skill damage and rooting them.

skills.name: Brush Stroke - Yellow
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 0.5 Seconds Cooldown Tia can use different skills based on her current paintbrush's color. Yellow: Tia tosses her yellow paint tube in the targeted direction, which explodes, dealing skill damage to enemies and painting them Yellow. Enemies painted Yellow are slowed. Red: Tia swings her paintbrush, dealing skill damage, and painting enemies hit by the bristles Red. Enemies painted Red are slowed. Blue: Tia slams her paintbrush on the ground, dealing skill damage and painting enemies in range Blue. Enemies hit by the inner range take extra skill damage. Enemies are slowed. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Palette Swap - Yellow
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 0.02 Seconds Cooldown Tia changes the color of paint on her brush. Colors are always switched in the order of Yellow, Red, Blue. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: A Dash of Color - Yellow
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 13 Seconds Cooldown Tia dashes in the targeted direction, painting the ground behind her. Enemies in the path take skill damage and are painted the current color of her brush. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Full Rainbow
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 90 Seconds Cooldown

Tia paints with the largest paint brush in her collection in the targeted location, dealing skill damage to enemies in the area and stunning them. If the enemy was already painted, the stun duration is increased.

skills.name: Retail Spearman
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Each time Felix uses his skills, he performs two consecutive attacks to enemy targets for a certain amount of time. The cooldowns of Felix’s basic skills are shared and fixed. Basic attacks between skills grant Felix a stack of <color=white>Spearweaving</color>. After the skill is complete, the stacks are consumed, decreasing the cooldown of Felix's basic skills per stack. Felix also gains a shield depending on the number of stacks consumed. Effects of Final Cast are applied. Shared cooldown is not affected by cooldown reduction effects.

skills.name: Wind Scar!
skills.tooltip: No Cost Felix dashes and swings his spear in the targeted location, dealing skill damage. Wind Scar can be recast up to 2 more times and its final cast is enhanced. Final Cast: Felix deals skill damage and knocks enemies airborne. For each stack of Spearweaving, Felix deals true damage and knocks the enemy airborne. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Thunder Strike!
skills.tooltip: No Cost Felix lunges his spear in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage. Thunder Strike can be recast up to 2 times and its final cast is enhanced. Final Cast: Felix deals damage, roots the target hit, and dashes towards them if hit. The root duration is increased for each stack of Spearweaving. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Crescent Wave!
skills.tooltip: No Cost Felix steps back and sweeps his spear in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage and evading basic attacks. Crescent Wave can be recast up to 2 times and its final cast is enhanced. Final Cast: Felix deals more damage and Omnisyphon is increased based on the number of Spearweaving stacks consumed. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Tempest Hydra
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 60 Seconds Cooldown Felix channels power into his spear. Upon being recast, Felix becomes unstoppable and stabs in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage, granting him stacks of Spearweaving, and enhancing his basic skills. If Tempest Hydra is fully charged, enemies hit are stunned. Felix can change direction while he's channeling power, and becomes immune to Crowd Control when charging. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Winter Queen's Dominion
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 7 Seconds Cooldown

When Elena performs a basic attack or skill, she constructs a <color=white>Glacial Field</color>, applying <color=white>Chill</color> to enemies in it. When Elena deals skill damage, the target's <color=white>Chilled</color> is increased. <color=white>Chilled</color> enemies are slowed. When an enemy's reaches <color=white>Chill</color>, they are stunned and become <color=white>Frozen</color>. <color=white>Frozen</color>: If target is hit by Elena or her allies, the target takes takes additional skill damage breaking out of the <color=white>Frozen</color> status. Targets that are released from the <color=white>Frozen</color> state will not be affected by <color=white>Chill</color> for a while.

skills.name: Crystal Elegance
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 8 Seconds Cooldown

Elena forms an icicle in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage to enemies. After a short duration, the icicle bursts, dealing skill damage once more, and reducing the cooldown of <color=white>Winter Queen's Dominion</color>.

skills.name: Double Axel
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 0.1 Seconds Cooldown (16 Seconds Charging Time)

Elena performs a jump in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage to enemies in her way, reducing the cooldown of <color=white>Crystal Elegance</color>. You can recast this skill. Casting the skill within a <color=white>Glacial Field</color> reduces the cooldown of <color=white>Double Axel</color>.

skills.name: Spiral
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 5 Seconds Cooldown

<color=green>Passive</color>: Elena recovers <color=white>Step Sequence</color> every second. On a <color=white>Glacial Field</color>, her recovery from <color=white>Step Sequence</color> and defense increase. Elena consumes <color=white>Step Sequence</color> every second to skate in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage to enemies in her way. This effect is only applied once. Elena can change her direction slightly while moving.

skills.name: Danse Macabre
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Elena lays down a giant spreading <color=white>Glacial Field</color>, dealing skill damage to enemies in contact. Enemies in the middle are instantly stunned and <color=white>Frozen</color> inside a giant glacier, receiving skill damage.

skills.name: Nature's Call
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Priya starts with an undetachable flower crown which can be enhanced by leveling up <color=white>Nature's Call</color>. Priya can grow a Flower of Saraswati by casting <color=white>Blossoming Melody</color> or <color=white>Portamento</color> which fully blooms later on. A fully bloomed Flower of Saraswati can be activated by casting <color=white>Blossoming Melody</color> or <color=white>Portamento</color> on it. A Flower of Saraswati instantly blooms when placed in a brush. The Flower immediately disappears if Priya moves out of range.

skills.name: Blossoming Melody
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 1 Seconds Cooldown (12 Seconds Charging Time)

Priya plays a short tune to grow a Flower of Saraswati in the targeted location and deals skill damage to enemies in range. Flowers cannot be grown on top of existing Flowers. The charge time of <color=white>Blossoming Melody</color> is reduced whenever a fully bloomed Flower is produced. <color=white>Full Bloom</color>: Target a fully bloomed Flower of Saraswati to make it explode into petals, dealing skill damage and knocking back enemies in range.

skills.name: Portamento
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown

<color=green>Passive</color>: Priya's movement speed is increased after stepping on a Flower of Saraswati. Allies can also receive effects. Priya sends out a screeching sound wave in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage to enemies hit and slowing them. After casting <color=white>Portamento</color>, Priya's next basic attack grows a Flower of Saraswati under the target. <color=white>Full Bloom</color>: Target a fully bloomed Flower of Saraswati to shield Priya and her allies in range, absorbing damage.

skills.name: Harmony of Parvati
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 11 Seconds Cooldown

Priya sends out 3 surrounding soundwaves, each dealing skill damage to enemies within range. Enemies hit twice are slowed, and enemies hit three times are rooted. Movement speed increases, and all skills excluding <color=white>Echoes of the Earth</color> can be cast while performing <color=white>Harmony of Parvati</color>.

skills.name: Echoes of the Earth
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Priya plays an earth-shaking serenade, becoming unstoppable but unable to cast other skills or perform basic attacks. Her taken damage is decreased. She then sends out a melodic echo, dealing skill damage to enemies. The echo causes roots to grow in three parts starting from the outside, dealing skill damage and causing enemies in range to dance. Flowers of Saraswati in range will bear fruit, which instantly heals Priya or her allies when picked up.

skills.name: Stargazing
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Adina's crystal ball generates celestial signs that alter the effect of her skills. Casting a skill consumes Adina's currently selected celestial sign (the 2nd bar below the HP bar), changing the effect of the skill depending on the sign consumed. Once all signs have been consumed, Adina enters a state of <color=white>Stargazing</color>, refilling all empty slots with new celestial signs and increasing her movement speed.

skills.name: Luminary
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 6 Seconds Cooldown

Adina launches a celestial sphere in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage to enemies hit. <color=white>Celestial Sign</color> <color=#80B9FF>Sun</color>: Damage is increased. <color=#6B71FF>Moon</color>: Fires a moon sphere that explodes on impact, stunning the enemy. <color=#A97EEF>Star</color>: Fires a comet that leaves a tail behind, increasing the movement speed of allies touching the tail. <color=#80B9FF>Sun Conjunct</color> : When casting Luminary with two aligned Sun signs, Adina fires a larger sun sphere, dealing skill damage to enemies, and true damage proportional to Max HP for a designated period of time.

skills.name: Astral Trine
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 9 Seconds Cooldown

Adina draws an astral triangle at the targeted location, dealing skill damage to enemies hit and slowing them. <color=white>Celestial Sign</color> <color=#80B9FF>Sun</color>: Damage is increased. <color=#6B71FF>Moon</color>: Enemies hit are stunned. <color=#A97EEF>Star</color>: The triangle is completed faster, and allies gain a shield. <color=#6B71FF>Moon Conjunct</color> : When casting Astral Trine with two aligned Moon symbols, Adina draws two triangles each dealing damage. The first triangle stuns enemies hit, and the second triangle slows enemies hit.

skills.name: Fated Horizon
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 10 Seconds Cooldown

Adina marks her target and deals skill damage. A celestial body then descends upon the target, dealing skill damage to enemies in range. Does not damage allies. <color=white>Celestial Sign</color> <color=#80B9FF>Sun </color>: Damage is increased. <color=#6B71FF>Moon </color>: A Moon sphere descends upon the target, stunning enemies hit. <color=#A97EEF>Star </color>: A comet quickly descends upon the target. When cast on an ally, they are healed from the mark. <color=#A97EEF>Star Conjunct</color> : When casting Fated Horizon with two aligned Star symbols, the comet leaves behind a nebula, healing allies inside.

skills.name: Celestial Prophecy
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 0.1 Seconds Cooldown Effect: Celestial Prophecy Adina swaps the saved sign (the 2nd bar below the HP bar) with one in her crystal ball, altering her fated path. Passive: Conjunction When aligning Celestial Signs, Adina can cast a powerful Conjunct skill by consuming both the 2nd and 3rd bar. Conjunct skills can be enhanced by leveling Celestial Prophecy. Sun x2 : Enhances Luminary(Q), increasing damage dealt. Moon x2 : Enhances Astral Trine(W), increasing damage dealt. Star x2 : Enhances Fated Horizon(E), providing extra recovery. Conjunct skills can be cast only once per Stargazing cycle. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Warrior's Grit
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

<color=white>Rattled</color>: Enemies knocked into a wall by Markus or his skills become <color=white>Rattled</color>, taking skill damage. Enemies are stunned and slowed for a short period of time. Enemies coming into contact with the knocked back target are also Rattled and are applied the same effect. <color=white>Fatal Blow</color>: When Markus strikes a <color=white>Rattled</color> enemy in range with a basic attack, Markus becomes Unstoppable, dealing additional skill damage and removing the <color=white>Rattled</color> debuff from all enemies.

skills.name: Art of War
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 7 Seconds Cooldown

For his next 3 basic attacks, Markus's Attack Speed is increased and his basic attacks deal additional skill damage. He recovers HP based on the additional skill damage dealt. The buff expires if Markus does not perform a basic attack within the established time frame. Casting <color=white>Art of War</color> also increases Markus's movement speed for a moment when moving towards an enemy test subject.

skills.name: Violent Swing
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 13 Seconds Cooldown

Markus smashes the ground in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage and knocking enemies airborne. If he hits an enemy inside the <color=white>Tectonic Rift</color>, all hit enemies are hurled behind him.

skills.name: Fearless Assault
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown

Markus charges in the targeted direction. Markus stops when he collides with a target, dealing skill damage and knocking them back.

skills.name: Smash to Smithereens
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Markus jumps to the targeted location and lands on the ground, creating a <color=white>Tectonic Rift</color> in the area, dealing skill damage to enemies hit and reducing their defense. Enemies hit are also slowed, decaying over time. Targets that are knocked airborne or knocked back within a <color=white>Tectonic Rift</color> take <color=white>Rattled</color> damage and become <color=white>Rattled</color>. This effect can only trigger once inside a <color=white>Tectonic Rift</color>. Marking enemies with <color=white>Rattled</color> reduces the cooldown of <color=white>Smash to Smithereens</color>.

skills.name: Deckhand's Draw
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Karla's Max Attack Speed is limited, and her Skill Amp increases based on how much her Attack Speed exceeds the limit. Karla charges Readiness for a certain amount of time. Uncharged basic attacks consume some of her Readiness and deal skill damage. Full charged basic attacks consume the entirety of her Readiness, dealing skill damage and reducing Movement Speed. All unconnected harpoons are installed on the ground. Her basic attacks do not automatically fire.

skills.name: Piercing Chain
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 0.75 Seconds Cooldown Karla fires her harpoon in the targeted direction, dealing basic attack damage. Fired harpoons stay hooked to terrain for a few seconds. Karla can chain herself to her harpoons, but the chains break if Karla moves too far away from her harpoon. The cooldown of Piercing Chain is reduced based on Karla's Attack Speed. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Salvage
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 2.5 Seconds Cooldown Karla salvages all chained harpoons, dealing skill damage to enemies hit and slowing them. If this skill hits an enemy, Karla gains Readiness and the cooldown of Grappling Maneuver gets reduced based on the number of enemies hit. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Grappling Maneuver
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 20 Seconds Cooldown

Karla grapples to the targeted harpoon and rebounds in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage. Targeting an unchained harpoon with this skill rechains Karla to the harpoon.

skills.name: Shackling Anchor
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Karla launches a giant harpoon at a targeted location that deals skill damage, shackles all enemies within range, and slows them. After a few seconds, enemies still shackled are pulled towards the harpoon, taking skill damage and becoming stunned.

skills.name: Duty Calls!
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Estelle recovers hp periodically. She can also revive downed allies faster, and heal them for additional HP.

skills.name: Suppression
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 7 Seconds Cooldown

Estelle empowers her shield, dealing additional skill damage on her next basic attack and stunning enemies.

skills.name: First Response
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 7 Seconds Cooldown

Estelle slams the ground with her shield, dealing skill damage to enemies in range, slowing them. When cast during Hazard Shield (E), Estelle can move while spraying enemies in range with her extinguisher, dealing skill damage and slowing their movement speed with each hit.

skills.name: Emergency Extinguish
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 7 Seconds Cooldown

skills.name: Hazard Shield
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 16 Seconds Cooldown

[Hazard Shield] Estelle spreads her Hazard Shield, blocking and destroying enemy projectiles. Right after casting, she blocks all incoming attacks without taking damage. Afterwards, the damage she takes is reduced. Casting a skill once more after charging ends her shielded state. [Forcible Entry] When cast during Hazard Shield, Estelle charges forward and stops on impact, dealing skill damage to the target and knocking them back. During the charge, Estelle is Unstoppable and instantly destroys objectives such as Telephoto Cameras.

skills.name: Forcible Entry
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 2 Seconds Cooldown

skills.name: Helitack Stat!
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

[Cast on Self] Estelle shields herself and requests a helitack backup.The helitack will then locate Estelle’s coordinates and drop a hydro bomb on the location dealing skill damage, and slows enemies hit. [Cast on Ally] Estelle shields her ally and requests a helitack backup. Later, Estelle drops from her helitack, instantly teleporting to her ally, dealing skill damage to enemies in range and knocking them airborne.

skills.name: Unmatched Discipline
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Whenever Piolo is out of combat, he gains a stack of [Well-Trained]. If he rests for 2 or more seconds, he gains additional stacks once he's finished. If Piolo casts [The Punisher] while [Well-Trained], his next Basic Attack will deal additional skill damage.

skills.name: Helicopter Spin / Chokeslam
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 9 Seconds Cooldown

<color=white>Helicopter Spin</color>: Piolo spins his nunchaku in the targeted direction, dealing continuous skill damage to enemies in range and enhanced damage every certain amount of time. If Helicopter Spin was cast with full duration or if it dealt enhanced damage for a fixed number of times, Piolo is able to cast <color=white>Chokeslam</color>. <color=white>Chokeslam</color>: Piolo slams in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage depending on whether they are within the inner or outer indictator. Enemies within the inner indicator that take damage by the outer indicator are also slowed down.

skills.name: Figure Eight / Hammer Throw
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown

<color=white>Figure Eight</color>: Piolo wildly spins his nunchakus around himself, deflecting projectiles and becoming Immune to Crowd Control. When the spin ends, Piolo is able to activate <color=white>Hammer Throw</color>. <color=white>Hammer Throw</color>: Piolo performs an upwards spin, dealing skill damage. While casting Hammer Throw, Piolo's movement speed is increased.

skills.name: Stalled Throw / Skyward Pummel
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 10 Seconds Cooldown

<color=white>Stalled Throw</color>: Piolo channels in preparation to throw his nunchakus. The range and damage of the skill increases with channel time. When recast, Piolo throws his nunchakus in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage to enemies hit and charging into them. Enemies reached take additional skill damage and are knocked back. Channeling for a fixed amount of time grants a stack of Stalled Throw. Piolo is only able to activate <color=white>Skyward Pummel</color> after successfully hitting an enemy with Stalled Throw. <color=white>Skyward Pummel</color>: Piolo swings his nunchaku in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage and knocking enemies airborne.

skills.name: The Punisher
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 6 Seconds Cooldown

<color=green>Passive</color>: Whenever <color=#ffffff>Chokeslam</color>, <color=#ffffff>Hammer Throw</color>, or <color=#ffffff>Skyward Pummel</color> become available, Piolo gains a stack of Focus. Piolo loses a Focus stack every certain amount of time outside of combat. Piolo uses a stack of Focus and dashes in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage to enemies in his path. On-hit, Piolo gains a shield. Performing a basic attack after using a skill will reduce skill cooldown except for weapons skills and The Punisher. While [Well-Trained], attack speed increases.

skills.name: Play
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Martina’s 4K UHD Camera spends power from its battery to perform basic attacks. While the battery is recharging, Martina cannot basic attack. Martina's basic attacks reveal her current target. When Martina gains Attack Speed, also her Attack Power is increased at a ratio. Combine <color=#35CB38>Telephoto Camera</color> and <color=#D6D6D6>Branch</color>to create a <color=#35CB38>Trail Camera</color> with Infiltration. <color=#ffffff>[Interview]</color> Martina's experience in covering warfare allows her to intuitively sense nearby danger while interviewing. Nearby combat between test subjects will display a special ping on the minimap. Whenever Martina performs enough consecutive basic attacks on an enemy, she applies a mark to them. Hitting a marked enemy with a skill consumes the mark, dealing skill damage. <color=#ffd775>[Broadcast]</color> Martina's basic attacks and mark procs deal increased damage.

skills.name: Fast Forward - Interview
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 7 Seconds Cooldown

<color=#ffffff>[Interview]</color> Martina takes a snapshot in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage. If the skill hits a target, its cooldown is reduced. Consuming a mark with this skill will grant Martina a movement speed boost. <color=#ffd775>[Broadcast]</color> Damage and range is increased and consuming a mark grants extra movement and attack speed.

skills.name: Pause - Interview
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 1 Seconds Cooldown (14 Seconds Charging Time)

<color=#ffffff>[Interview]</color> Martina installs a hidden camera, gaining vision its surrounding area. Hitting the camera with <color=white>Fast Forward</color> will cause the camera to take a snapshot in Martina’s direction, dealing skill damage and slowing enemies hit. <color=#ffd775>[Broadcast]</color> Hidden camera snapshots now root targets hit, and Martina becomes able to hold and install an increased amount of cameras.

skills.name: Rewind - Interview
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 17 Seconds Cooldown

<color=#ffffff>[Interview]</color> Martina dashes in the targeted direction, leaving a videotape behind. Martina then enters the Rewind state for a few seconds, increasing her Movement Speed. Exiting the Rewind state causes Martina to dash back to the videotape, becoming Immune to Crowd Control, slowing enemies down. Recast to exit Rewind before the end of its duration. <color=#ffd775>[Broadcast]</color> Enemies hit by Martina while she dashes back are stunned instead, and Martina heals herself for a percent of damage received while in Rewind upon returning to her videotape.

skills.name: Record - Interview
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 20 Seconds Cooldown

<color=#ffffff>[Interview]</color> Martina records in the targeted direction. If the target comes into range while she's recording, her movement speed is increased for the recording duration. If she catches a target on film, Martina gains a <color=white>Record Stack</color> and her Movement Speed is increased. Whenever Martina has enough <color=white>Record Stacks</color>, she completes her interview and goes into <color=#ffd775>Broadcast</color> mode, enhancing her skills. <color=#819FF7>Standard Footage Conditions</color>: Film 2 <color=#2ECCFA>Headline Targets</color> to gain Record Stacks and Weapon Mastery. <color=#819FF7>Corpse Footage Conditions</color>: Film the corpse of 1 <color=#2ECCFA>Headline Target</color> to gain Record Stacks and Weapon Mastery. (Max Stacks are limited and she cannot record the same corpse twice) <color=#2ECCFA>Headline Targets</color>: Enemy Test Subjects, Tree of Life, Meteorite, Alpha, Omega, Wickeline, Gamma After recording a target other than Tree of Life or Meteorite, she cannot film the same target for a certain period of time. <color=#ffd775>[Broadcast]</color> Martina damages enemies in the targeted direction, dealing an additional burst of damage to enemies hit and stunning enemies in the center when the skill ends.

skills.name: Weapon Case
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

<color=white>Grim Merchant</color>: After using her skill, Haze takes out a new Assault Rifle with full bullets loaded from her Weapon Case for 0.75 seconds. While taking out her Assault Rifle, Haze cannot use basic attacks, but her next basic attack deals extra skill damage to enemies hit. <color=white>Grim Merchant</color> is only applied while in Assault Rifle Form. <color=white>Weapon Case</color>: Haze uses different types of guns for each skill, when the skill ends, she takes out a new Assault Rifle from her Weapon Case and activates <color=white>Grim Merchant</color>.

skills.name: 40mm Grenade
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 2.5 Seconds Cooldown (10 Seconds Charging Time)

<color=white>Assault Rifle Form</color>: Haze launches a grenade, dealing skill damage to enemies hit. Haze can hold two charges of grenades.

skills.name: SMG Burst
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

<color=white>SMG Form</color>: Haze focuses for a moment and burst fires her SMG to the front, dealing skill damage and discarding her SMG.

skills.name: Rocket Acceleration
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 0.6 Seconds Cooldown

<color=white>Rocket Launcher Form</color>: Haze pierces her enemies by firing Rocket Acceleration, dealing skill damage to enemies hit and slowing them. Half the damage splashes in an area behind the targets. The rocket accelerates over time, widening its range and increasing damage. This skill shares cooldown with basic attacks and is not affected by cooldown reduction stats.

skills.name: Shotgun
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 15 Seconds Cooldown

Haze steps back to fire her shotgun, dealing skill damage to enemies hit and stunning them for a moment. If used while in <color=white>SMG Form</color> or <color=white>Rocket Launcher Form</color>, the weapon is discarded and the relevant skill's cooldown is reduced.

skills.name: SMG
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown

<color=white>Swap to SMG Form</color>: Haze dashes slightly forward for a few seconds and swaps to SMG Form with 40 bullets. Haze is able to attack while moving with a SMG and can change targets using Attack Commands. Each attack deals skill damage every few seconds. The effect is triggered on basic attack hits every set number of shots. While maintaining this form, certain actions such as crafting and looting are limited and her <color=white>40mm Grenade</color> skill changes to <color=white>SMG Burst</color>. When SMG Form ends, the skill cooldown reduces proportionally to bullets remaining.

skills.name: Rocket Launcher
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 30 Seconds Cooldown

<color=white>Swap to Rocket Launcher Form</color>: Haze swings her weapon case, slowing enemies and dealing skill damage. Haze swaps to her Rocket Launcher Form for a few seconds with 4 rocket ammos. While in Rocket Launcher form, Haze's range and attack speed are fixed, and her movement speed is reduced. Critical strike is not applied to her basic attacks, which splash additional skill damage. While in this form, <color=white>40mm Grenade</color> skill changes to <color=white>Rocket Acceleration</color> skill. When Rocket Launcher Form ends, the skill cooldown reduces proportionally to bullets remaining.

skills.name: Exploit
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

If the same enemy is hit 3 times, Isaac deals extra skill damage, and his movement speed increases. He recovers a certain amount of HP, equal to the amount of damage Exploit dealt.

skills.name: Swoop
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 10 Seconds Cooldown

Isaac charges toward an enemy, striking and dealing skill damage.

skills.name: Reinforce
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 9 Seconds Cooldown

Isaac's weapon grows stronger, and his next Basic Attack or Basic Skill is strengthened, dealing extra skill damage. If Exploit triggers when using an enhanced Basic Attack or Basic Skill, Basic Skill Cooldowns are decreased.

skills.name: Hound / Arrest
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 15 Seconds Cooldown

Isaac quickly charges and prepares his next skill. Upon reuse: Pulls in enemies in front of him and destroys their shield, dealing skill damage and stunning them. Enemies pulled in have their shields reduced.

skills.name: The Heavy Hand of the Law
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Isaac strongly slams into the ground, dealing skill damage and pushing enemies without Exploit out of range. Based on how many stacks of Exploit Marks the target has, Isaac deals additional skill damage to the enemy based on their lost HP, and greatly slows them for a short while.

skills.name: Artigianato
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 10 Seconds Cooldown

<color=white>Artigianato</color>: Tazia gains 1 stack of <color=white>Shard Collection</color> each time a <color=white>Glass Shard</color> is shattered. If she gains a stack of 4 <color=white>Shard Collection</color>, a <color=white>Glass Sword</color> is created. <color=white>Difettoso</color>: Tazia's next basic attack deals skill damage. A <color=white>Glass Shard</color> is created at the spot where a basic attack hits.

skills.name: Stiletto
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 0.75 Seconds Cooldown (10 Seconds Charging Time)

<color=green>Passive</color>: Tazia creates a <color=white>Glass Blade</color> after a certain amount of time. When Tazia approaches a <color=white>Glass Shard</color>, Tazia shatters it and recovers some of <color=white>Glass Blade</color>'s charge time. She can keep a maximum of 4 <color=white>Glass Blades</color>. Throw the <color=white>Glass Blade</color> in front of you to deal skill damage and create <color=white>Glass Shards</color>. <color=white>Spada</color>: If you have a <color=white>Glass Sword</color>, throw the <color=white>Glass Sword</color> at an approaching enemy to deal skill damage and push them back. Also creates <color=white>Glass Shards.</color>. <color=white>Glass Sword</color> pierces after the first impact, moves forward and explodes, dealing skill damage and creating additional <color=white>Glass Shards</color>.

skills.name: Spada
skills.tooltip: No Cost

skills.name: Fiasco
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 20 Seconds Cooldown

Creates an unstable glass barrier at a chosen location. If an enemy collides with the barrier, the glass breaks, dealing damage and stunning them. After the glass barrier breaks, <color=white>Glass Shards</color> are created at each end.

skills.name: Pulizia
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 13 Seconds Cooldown

Quickly move to a specified point and shatter the surrounding <color=white>Glass Shards</color>. <color=white>Glass Blade</color> is recovered to the number of destroyed <color=white>Glass Shards</color> If a <color=white>Glass Shard</color> is shattered, Tazia gains Shield and swings the Glass Blade, dealing skill damage to enemies and slowing them. This skill can be used again within a certain amount of time. If 2 or more <color=white>Glass Shards</color> are destroyed, Damage amount and Shield amount increase per every additional shattered <color=white>Glass Shard</color>.

skills.name: Paradiso
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Create a large sword, shattering all <color=white>Glass Shards</color> within range. Slows enemies within range. Enemies directly hit by this skill take skill damage and are slowed. If large sword duration is over, or <color=white>Glass Blades</color> or <color=white>Glass Sword</color> is used and the large sword is destroyed, enemies in range take skill damage. Damage increases proportionally for every shattered <color=white>Glass Shard</color>.

skills.name: Catitude
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

When Irem enters a different area, her Vision Range increases. After staying in the same area for a certain amount of time, instead of Vision Range, her other abilities are enhanced. As Irem: Attack Speed Increased As a cat: Defense Increase Eating food made with fish immediately recovers her HP for a fixed amount of Max Food HP Regen.

skills.name: Bouncy Ball
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 7 Seconds Cooldown

<color=#ffd775>Irem:</color> Irem throws a bouncy ball, which becomes stronger with each bounce and deals skill damage to enemies in range. When the ball hits an enemy, it stops bouncing and leaves a fish mark.

skills.name: Cat Pawnch
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 5.5 Seconds Cooldown

<color=#ffd775>Cat:</color> Next basic attack, Irem charges to her target, dealing additional skill damage. If you attack a target with a Cat Bell Mark, the enemy is rooted. Afterward, Irem strikes continuously, and each enemy within range takes skill damage. If the target is affected by crowd control, deal additional skill damage.

skills.name: Let's Be Friends!
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 15 Seconds Cooldown

<color=#ffd775>Irem:</color> Irem creates a small field that slows enemies and deals skill damage to enemies in range. Enemies hit by the damage are charmed. The slow is maintained for a short amount of time after the enemy leaves the field.

skills.name: Hissy Fit
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 9 Seconds Cooldown

<color=#ffd775>Cat:</color> Irem spins in the air, powerfully striking enemies with her tail, dealing skill damage and knocking up enemies airborne. Damaging an enemy with this skill reduces the cooldown of <color=white>Love Jump! ♥</color> and <color=white>Purrfect Pounce!</color>.

skills.name: Love Jump! ♥
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 17 Seconds Cooldown

<color=#ffd775>Irem:</color> Irem quickly moves toward a certain direction and leaves a Fish Mark at her original spot.

skills.name: Purrfect Pounce!
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 11 Seconds Cooldown

<color=#ffd775>Cat:</color> Irem leaps, dealing skill damage to enemies within range. Leaping towards a Fish Mark increases jump distance.

skills.name: Pet Me!
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 1.5 Seconds Cooldown Irem: Irem changes into a cat. If a Fish Mark is created with Bouncy Ball or Love Jump! ♥, Irem's next basic attack has increased range, deals skill damage, and leaves a Cat Bell Mark for a short amount of time. The target with a Cat Bell Mark shares their vision to Irem. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Love Me!
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 1.5 Seconds Cooldown Cat: Cat changes into Irem. Moving to a Fish Mark as a cat grants a shield that absorbs damage. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Sapphire Protocol
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 10 Seconds Cooldown

Theodore becomes invisible and his movement speed increases when exiting brushes. Theodore also obtains a shield that blocks damage. Any actions other than moving end his invisibility. Hitting with a Basic Attack reduces <color=white>Energy Cannon</color> and <color=white>other base skills</color>' cooldown.

skills.name: Energy Cannon
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 13 Seconds Cooldown

Charging: Theodore charges his railgun with energy, slowly reducing his Movement Speed. Firing: Upon reuse, a ray is fired in a specified direction, dealing skill damage to enemies. Allies recover HP. Range increases with charging time. When <color=white>Energy Cannon</color> hits <color=white>Power Screen</color>, another ray also fires from the front of the Power Screen, dealing skill damage to enemies. Allies recover HP over time.

skills.name: Power Screen
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 1 Seconds Cooldown (12 Seconds Charging Time)

Theodore creates a Power Screen in a specified location. His <color=white>basic attack</color> bullets and <color=white>Sparknade</color> that pass through the Power Screen are dispersed around the enemy. Basic attacks that pass through the screen deal additional skill damage, and the projectile speed and range of Sparknade increases.

skills.name: Sparknade
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

<color=green>Passive</color>: If <color=white>Energy Cannon</color> or <color=white>Sparknade</color> hit an enemy, the range of the next basic attack increases. Theodore throws a Sparknade, slowing enemies down. <color=white>Target</color> is locked on, and Theodore gains vision of the target. When he attacks the target with a basic attack or skill, he deals extra skill damage and roots the target.

skills.name: Blast Energy Field
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Theodore maximizes his energy, creating a <color=white>Blast Energy Field</color> in a specified direction. Movement Speed of all allies moving toward that direction is increased. It fires a strong energy wave at enemies, dealing skill damage. After firing, Theodore becomes <color=white>Overcharged</color>. His Attack Speed increases, and maximum charging time of <color=white>Energy Cannon</color> is reduced.

skills.name: The Possession
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Ly Anh continues to resist so the ghost doesn't take over her body. Damage from Basic Attack differs depending on her current state. Ly Anh gets Possessed, recovering HP based on her lost HP. Due to the spirit inside her, her cruelty is awakened against her will. In Possessed or Ghost states, she recovers HP and deals additional true damage when dealing skill damage.

skills.name: Run Away! / Ghastly Grip
skills.tooltip:
HP: 4 / 4 Seconds Cooldown

<color=#ffffC2>Human:</color> Ly Anh gets controlled by the ghost to stab, dealing skill damage to the target. <color=#ffffC2>Possessed :</color> The Possessed Ly Anh roots and deals skill damage to targets within the area.

skills.name: I'm So Sorry... / Phantom Ripper
skills.tooltip:
HP: 4 / 11 Seconds Cooldown

<color=#ffffC2>Human:</color> The ghost controls Ly Anh to swing the dagger in front of her, dealing skill damage. If it hits, enemy Movement Speed is reduced and gradually returns over time. <color=#ffffC2>Possessed :</color> The Possessed Ly Anh swipes her claws in front of her and deals skill damage. If the skill hits, she gains a stack of <color=white>Thrash</color> and her Movement Speed is increased. Increased Movement Speed returns to normal over time. Depending on stacks, the amount of HP consumed when using skills increases. If she hits a target, the cooldown of <color=white>Ghastly Grip</color> and <color=white>Razor Claws</color> are reduced.

skills.name: Please Move! / Razor Claws
skills.tooltip:
HP: 4 / 16 Seconds Cooldown

<color=#ffffC2>Human:</color> The dagger drags Ly Anh, dealing skill damage to enemies within the path. If it hits, she can recast the skill. <color=#ffffC2>Possessed:</color> The Possessed Ly Anh slams her claws, dealing skill damage. She then drags the target, dealing skill damage.

skills.name: Freedom
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 70 Seconds Cooldown

Ly Anh is completely overtaken by the Ghost. The ghost flies out toward a fixed direction, dealing skill damage. Ly Anh's body remains in the original position. In Ghost state, Max HP and Movement Speed increase. She deals skill damage when using a Basic Attack, and Ly Anh gains a stack of [Killing Instinct]. Attack Speed increases for every stack of [Killing Instinct]. Can stack up to 7 times. Every 4th Basic Attack fears the target. Enemies within range of the target are also feared. If the ghost is alive when Skill use is complete, Ly Anh returns to her Human state at the ghost's location. If the Ghost dies, Ly Anh returns to her Human state in her original position. <color=white>End Conditions:</color> The ghost leaves the designated range, another skill is used, the Ghost dies, or stacks of Invasion reach 0.

skills.name: Dream of a Butterfly
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 8 Seconds Cooldown

<color=green>Fantasy:</color> Basic Attacks deal extra skill damage every few seconds. <color=green>Dream of a Butterfly:</color> Hitting an enemy with a skill applies 1 stack of <color=white>Dream of a Butterfly</color>. Upon getting 4 stacks, a butterfly emerges to the front dealing skill damage over time. Vanya also receives a shield. The shield wears off slowly based on her Skill Amp.

skills.name: Guiding Light
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 11 Seconds Cooldown

Vanya sends out a guiding Butterfly, dealing skill damage. Hitting a target or flying until the end of its range makes the butterfly go back to Vanya, dealing damage on the way back. Fetching a returning butterfly reduces cooldown. If Guiding Light hits an enemy, the butterfly grants Vanya a <color=white>Dream of a Butterfly</color> shield.

skills.name: Butterfly Embrace
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 6 Seconds Cooldown

<color=white>Butterfly Embrace:</color> Vanya floats in the air, dealing skill damage over time and gaining a decaying movement speed boost. She can activate <color=white>The Butterfly Effect</color> before her skill effect is over. <color=white>The Butterfly Effect:</color> Vanya flies high up in the air, becoming untargetable and dealing skill damage upon landing. Using this skill increases cooldown.

skills.name: The Butterfly Effect
skills.tooltip: No Cost

skills.name: Yearning
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 16 Seconds Cooldown

Vanya flies, becoming unstoppable and dealing skill damage to enemies. The outer range of her open wings deals even more skill damage and enemies are slowed.

skills.name: Sand Dust
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

The illusory butterfly spreads Sand Dust, dealing skill damage. Targets hit fall into a drowsy state, are slowed down gradually, and then fall asleep. Targets hit while asleep wake up, taking skill damage.

skills.name: Blue & Red
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

<color=green>Passive:</color> When Debi's in control, her Defense is increased, and when Marlene takes over, her basic attack range is increased. Debi & Marlene's basic attacks deal reduced damage. The twins' basic attacks and skills ink their targets with <color=white>Blue & Red</color>, respectively. These effects can stack. When <color=white>Blue & Red</color>'s ink changes from one color to another, the original color disappears, dealing skill damage to the target and increasing Debi & Marlene's Movement Speed. Additionally, the cooldown of <color=white>Cover Me, Marlene!</color> or <color=white>Now, Debi!</color> is reduced when the colors are inked and <color=white>Blue & Red</color> deals damage.

skills.name: Hard Slash
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 4 Seconds Cooldown

<color=white>Debi: </color>Debi slams her sword forward, dealing skill damage. Hitting an enemy increases her Attack Speed.

skills.name: Crescent Slash
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 4.5 Seconds Cooldown

<color=white>Marlene: </color>Marlene releases energy, dealing skill damage. Hitting an enemy increases her Attack Speed.

skills.name: Whirl Dance
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown

<color=white>Debi: </color>Debi swings her sword wildly, dealing skill damage, and blocking enemy projectiles and basic attacks in range.

skills.name: Crescent Dance
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 11 Seconds Cooldown

<color=white>Marlene: </color>Marlene spins quickly and unleashes multiple bolts of energy that fly toward nearby enemies. Enemies take skill damage with each hit and are inked with <color=white>Blue & Red</color> every certain number of hits. Enemies already hit by the energy take reduced damage.

skills.name: Cover Me, Marlene!
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 15 Seconds Cooldown Passive: Debi & Marlene have increased Movement Speed when they switch with each other. Debi: Call Marlene to switch. When switching, she moves backwards and releases energy, dealing skill damage to the first enemy she hits. After a short period of time, that enemy and all nearby enemies are slowed. Debi remains in her switched position for a short time, and using Crescent Slash causes Debi to dash forward, dealing skill damage to enemies in her path and knocking them airborne. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Now, Debi!
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 17 Seconds Cooldown Passive: Debi & Marlene have increased Movement Speed when they switch with each other. Marlene: Call Debi to switch. When switching, Debi dashes forward, dealing skill damage to enemies in her path and knocking them airborne. Marlene remains in her switched position for a short time, and using Hard Slash causes Marlene to move backwards and release energy, dealing skill damage to the first enemy hit. That enemy and all nearby enemies are slowed for a short period of time. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Twins Rush
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Debi and Marlene dash together, dealing skill damage to all enemies in their path before pulling them towards them and stunning them for a short period of time. Enemies take multiple additional hits of true damage and are inked with <color=white>Blue & Red</color>.

skills.name: Relic Quest
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

<color=white>Excavation Control</color>: When Arda starts collecting Tree of Life and Meteorite, a zone is created that silences enemies around him. The created zone lasts for the duration of the collection. <color=white>Artifact Analysis</color>: If Arda uses a relic that deals damage to an enemy, he gains <color=white>Essence of Antiquity</color>. When enough <color=white>Essence of Antiquity</color> are stacked, the lantern releases a mystical force that recovers Arda and nearby allies HP.

skills.name: Shamash's Papyrus
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 8 Seconds Cooldown

Unfolds the Shamash's Papyrus in the targeted direction. Enemies hit by the Shamash's Papyrus take skill damage.

skills.name: Babylon's Cube
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 13 Seconds Cooldown

Summon the Babylon's Cube at the targeted location. Babylon's Cube deals skill damage and slows enemies in the area. After a short time, the Babylon's Cube disappears, dealing skill damage and stunning enemies in the area.

skills.name: Nimrod's Tombstone
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

Dropping a Nimrod's Tombstone at the targeted location deals skill damage to enemies within range and knocks them back.

skills.name: Unleashed Power
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 20 Seconds Cooldown

Arda deciphers the origin hidden in the relic and restores its original abilities. Boosts the next basic skill you use for a certain period of time.

skills.name: Tearing Blade
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown

Abigail's next basic attack deals additional skill damage and reduces the target's defense. When hitting an enemy with a skill, the cooldown of <color=white>Tearing Blade</color> is reduced.

skills.name: Binary Spin
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 7 Seconds Cooldown

Abigail swings her scythe. The first spin deals some skill damage and the second spin deals stronger skill damage. When casting Binary Spin, her movement speed is briefly increased.

skills.name: Dimensional Cleave
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 11 Seconds Cooldown

Abigail cuts through space, dealing skill damage. Hitting an enemy gives her a shield on hit that absorbs damage for a period of time. Targets hit by the skill are marked with <color=white>Coordinates</color>, granting Abigail vision of her targets for a period of time.

skills.name: Quantum Leap
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 13 Seconds Cooldown

Abigail teleports through a dimensional rift to a targeted location around the enemy, dealing skill damage. When used on a target marked with <color=white>Coordinates</color>, the cooldown of <color=white>Quantum Leap</color> is reset.

skills.name: Dimensional Strike
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Abigail hides in a different dimension and becomes untargetable for a while. She then lands, dealing skill damage and slowing enemies down. Targets hit by the skill are marked with <color=white>Coordinates</color>, granting Abigail vision of her targets for a period of time.

skills.name: Plasma Barrier
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 18 Seconds Cooldown

Alonso becomes immune to immobilizing effects for a short time. This effect is reactivated if he takes no damage for a period of time. When Alonso's skill immobilizes an enemy, he recovers HP.

skills.name: Energy Punch
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 7 Seconds Cooldown

Alonso throws a Magnetic Punch forward that deals skill damage and <color=white>Connects</color> with enemies it hits. When Alonso is facing a <color=white>Connected</color> target, his movement speed increases depending on the distance between him and his target. Performing a basic attack on <color=white>Connected</color> enemies will break the connection, dealing skill damage and briefly stunning them.

skills.name: Bouncing Shield
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

Alonso unleashes a magnetic shield that blocks attacks, reducing damage taken from enemies in front. The shield fires waves at incresingly faster intervals dealing skill damage. Reusing or ending the skill deals skill damage.

skills.name: Al Ataque!
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

Alonso points at his target and puts a metal ring on them. After a moment, he dashes towards the target, dealing skill damage and rooting them.

skills.name: Magnetic Field
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Alonso briefly pulls nearby enemies to him, dealing skill damage. He then collects metal fragments from the ground, recovering HP and dealing skill damage over time to enemies. Enemies in the outer range are slowed. Reusing or ending the skill deals skill damage based on the skill duration.

skills.name: Teddy Bear Attack!
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Upon hitting an ally test subject, a teddy bear spawns on the target. When an attack from an ally who has gained a teddy bear hits an enemy, the teddy bear flies away dealing additional skill damage. Dealing damage with the teddy bear reduces the cooldown of Leni's basic skill.

skills.name: Carrot Bazooka!
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown

Leni fires her Carrot Bazooka and is knocked back slightly. The carrot flies to the end of its range, or explodes if it hits an enemy or ally. When it explodes, it deals skill damage to enemies and heals allies.

skills.name: Whack-a-mole!
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 16 Seconds Cooldown

Leni jumps up and smashes her mallet on the targeted location, dealing skill damage and slowing enemies. Enemies hit in the center are slowed even more. Hitting an ally slows them for a short period of time, then increases their movement speed.

skills.name: Air Horn Gun!
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 9 Seconds Cooldown

Leni fires her Air Horn Gun!, dealing skill damage to enemies and stunning them for a certain amount of time. Allies hit gain a shield.

skills.name: Spring Launch!
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 20 Seconds Cooldown Leni starts the Spring Launch! dealing skill damage to enemies hit and sending them flying in the targeted direction. Enemies that hit a wall take skill damage and are slowed for a certain amount of time. Leni flies away too!

skills.name: Life and Death Seal
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Tsubame's basic attacks stack up <color=white>Life and Death Seal</color>. At max Stacks, Tsubame's basic attack unleashes <color=white>Life and Death Seal</color>, dealing skill damage.

skills.name: Shuriken Deployment
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 7 Seconds Cooldown

Tsubame throws 3 shuriken to the targeted location, dealing skill damage to enemies in the way. As the shuriken fly to the end of their path, they spin around, dealing skill damage and applying additional stacks to enemies with <color=white>Life and Death Seal</color> stacks. Enemies hit by the shuriken are slowed.

skills.name: Whirlwind
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 13 Seconds Cooldown

Tsubame moves concisely and faster. Her movement speed is increased, decaying over time. Her attack speed is also increased.

skills.name: The Art Of Camouflage
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 15 Seconds Cooldown

Tsubame leaves a <color=white>Wooden Log</color> at her location and spins in the targeted direction, becoming invisible. The skill can be reused after the spin. <color=white>Reuse:</color> Tsubame swaps places with the <color=white>Wooden Log</color>.

skills.name: Higuruma's Elimination Technique
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 50 Seconds Cooldown Tsubame quickly moves towards her enemy target, slashing through all enemies in her path and dealing skill damage. Increases damage based on the target's lost HP. Dealing damage to targets with max stacks of Life and Death Seal with Higuruma's Elimination Technique applies Life and Death Seal effects. The cooldown of Higuruma's Elimination Technique is reduced based on Life and Death Seal stacks. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Suppressed Rage
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

When Kenneth deals damage with a basic attack or skill, he gains stacks for a period of time. Kenneth's axe catches fire when fully stacked, dealing additional skill damage each time a basic attack or skill hits. He recovers HP equal to the damage dealt with this skill.

skills.name: Fury Strike
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 10 Seconds Cooldown

Kenneth swings his axe wildly, dealing skill damage and briefly knocking enemies airborne. <color=white>Suppressed Rage - Max Stacks:</color> Damage increases, and a portion of lost HP is recovered for each enemy hit.

skills.name: Inferno
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

Kenneth burns everything around him for a period of time, reducing the damage he takes. He also gains a shield that absorbs damage for a short time. The duration of this skill increases upon a basic attack hit.

skills.name: Fierce Attack
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 10 Seconds Cooldown

Kenneth charges forward, enhancing his basic attack for a short period of time, increasing his attack speed and converting some of the <color=white>Suppressed Rage</color> damage dealt by his basic attack into true damage. He deals additional skill damage, and some of the skill's cooldown is recovered upon the first enemy hit.

skills.name: Flame Crush
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Kenneth swings his axe upward, dealing skill damage. Enemies hit are knocked airborne for a short time, stunned, and take skill damage from Kenneth's spinning attack. He then slams his axe down, dealing skill damage and knocking enemies airborne for a short time at the landing point.

skills.name: Ashen Reaper
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

<color=#ffffC2>Ashen Reaper: </color>When Katja uses <color=white>Sharpshooter</color> or <color=white>Off-Limits</color>, she deals additional skill damage with her next basic attack. <color=#ffffC2>Bonus: </color>Katja gains Credits for clicking on the corpse of an enemy test subject she helped kill.

skills.name: Sharpshooter
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 7 Seconds Cooldown

Katja fires a bullet, dealing skill damage to the first enemy she hits. Damage increases proportionally to the distance the bullet travels. Upon hitting a target, her attack speed increases.

skills.name: Dart of Revelation
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 30 Seconds Cooldown

<color=green>Passive:</color> The drone activates the Security Console on Katja's behalf. The drone flies to the targeted direction and launches a scouting dart that grants her vision. The dart briefly reveals any enemy test subject it spots, and when it reaches the targeted location, it creates a wave that reduces traps and cameras' HP to 1. The wave remains for a period of time, granting vision.

skills.name: Off-Limits
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown

Katja fires a bullet forward, dealing skill damage while the recoil of her rifle pushes her backwards. If enemies are hit by the bullets they are slowed and Katja's movement speed increases.

skills.name: In a Blitz
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

The drone scans the targeted location. Katja fires bullets one at a time at scanned enemy test subjects in order of proximity, dealing skill damage. Damage increases with each shot. Enemy test subjects that get in the way of the bullets fired are hit by them instead.

skills.name: A Pure Heart
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Charlotte gains a stack of <color=white>A Pure Heart</color> every time nearby allies lose HP due to enemy attacks. Allies healed by her gain recovery and a shield per stack.

skills.name: Light Bearer
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 8 Seconds Cooldown

Charlotte creates a pool and sphere of light at a designated location, which last for a certain amount of time. The sphere of light flies towards the nearest enemy within range and attaches to them, exploding shortly after and dealing skill damage. Enemies hit are slowed for a few seconds, recovering their movement speed over time.

skills.name: Healing Light
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 8 Seconds Cooldown

Charlotte and her ally with the lowest HP are healed by the Healing Light.

skills.name: A Dash of Hope
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 9 Seconds Cooldown

Charlotte becomes untargetable and dashes to a designated ally character, granting them and herself a shield. Using this skill on herself instantly grants her a shield without dashing.

skills.name: Divine Intervention
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

<color=green>Passive</color>: Skill Amplification increases. Charlotte manifests a Divine Intervention. After a certain amount of time, nearby allies become invincible for a moment.

skills.name: Sly Thief
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 8 Seconds Cooldown

Darko performs a basic attack, stealing his target's defense.

skills.name: Loan Shark
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 3 Seconds Cooldown

Darko's movement speed increases when he moves towards an enemy test subject. His next basic attack deals additional skill damage and leaves a mark on the target. Using this skill on a marked target increases damage dealt.

skills.name: Got My Money?
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 9 Seconds Cooldown

Darko gets a shield that absorbs damage and slows enemy test subjects nearby. He gains additional shield per enemy test subject hit and steals their attack power.

skills.name: It's Pay Time!
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

Darko dashes forward and slams the ground, dealing skill damage and knocking enemies airborne.

skills.name: Intimidation Tactic
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 90 Seconds Cooldown

Darko grabs the enemy test subject, as he moves forward, supresses them and then slams them to the ground. Enemies nearby take skill damage and are slowed.

skills.name: Melody of Pain
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

<color=green>Passive:</color> Lenore converts her <color=#ffff00>Scream</color> stacks into <color=white>Accelerando</color>. Her cooldown reduction increases per stack of <color=white>Accelerando</color>. <color=white>Accelerando</color> stacks accumulated after max cooldown reduction is reached increase the cooldown reduction of her ultimate per stack. <color=white>Melody of Pain:</color> Dealing damage with a skill to an enemy character with low HP below, deals additional skill damage and grants her <color=#ffff00>Scream</color> stacks. This effect can be triggered on the same enemy character every certain amount of time. <color=white>Trill:</color> Every 3rd basic skill is enhanced.

skills.name: Staccato
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 7 Seconds Cooldown

Lenore plays her violin, releasing multiple sound waves that deal skill damage each to the first enemy hit and nearby enemies. <color=white>Enhanced:</color> Damage is increased.

skills.name: Fine
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown

Lenore gains a shield, absorbing damage, and deals skill damage to nearby enemies, rooting them. <color=white>Enhanced:</color> She gains additional shield and her movement speed is increased.

skills.name: Dal Segno
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 15 Seconds Cooldown

Lenore deals skill damage to enemies within range and pulls them towards the center. <color=white>Enhanced:</color> Enemies pulled towards the center are slowed.

skills.name: Capriccio of Agony
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 90 Seconds Cooldown

Lenore puts on a fantastic recital, releasing a resonating sound wave that envelops enemies hit for a certain period of time. The sound wave grows, dealing consecutive skill damage to all enemies within range, and stacking slow. The sound wave concludes with an explosion, dealing skill damage to all enemies within range, driving them Insane and making them attack nearby targets.

skills.name: Pain Sweet Pain
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Garnet, who is no stranger to pain, reduces incoming basic attack damage.

skills.name: Sadistic Slam & Spiked Echo
skills.tooltip:
Current HP 2% / 6 Seconds Cooldown

Garnet slams her weapon into the ground, dealing skill damage to enemies within the area and slowing them. You can reuse the skill within a certain period of time on-hit. Reuse: Garnet shoots spikes in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage to enemies within the area.

skills.name: Suppressed Pain
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

<color=green>Passive:</color> Each time Garnet uses a basic skill excluding <color=white>Suppressed Pain</color>, she gains a stack of <color=white>[Pain]</color>. At the end of the skill, all accumulated <color=white>[Pain]</color> stacks are consumed, reducing the cooldown of <color=white>Sadistic Slam & Spiked Echo</color> and <color=white>Twisted Obsession</color> per stack. Charging: Garnet is immobilized, reducing her damage taken for a certain amount of time. During this time, she recovers HP. End: She deals skill damage to enemies within the area based on the charging time and slows them. When fully charged, she roots her target. Additionally, she recovers HP.

skills.name: Twisted Obsession
skills.tooltip:
Current HP 2% / 12 Seconds Cooldown

Garnet dashes in her targeted direction, dealing skill damage to the first target hit and stunning them.

skills.name: Maiden's Embrace
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Garnet throws a chain in the targeted direction, rooting the first enemy character hit and dealing skill damage. The target is marked for a certain amount of time. If the target's HP drops below a certain threshold during this time, the skill can be recast. Reuse: Garnet embraces her marked target by dragging them into her Iron Maiden, executing the target. Garnet then emerges from her Iron Maiden, increasing her movement speed for a certain amount of time.

skills.name: The Power of Tao
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Yumin’s movement speed increases while in a Wind Zone. Using <color=white>Mystic Gale</color> or <color=white>Gust Surge</color> while on a Wind Zone consumes the wind and grants him a shield that absorbs damage for a short duration.

skills.name: Mystic Gale
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 7 Seconds Cooldown

Yumin unleashes 3 gusts of wind, dealing skill damage to enemies in his path. Each gust deals reduced damage to the second and subsequent targets hit. When this skill is used on a Wind Zone, Yumin releases a larger gust of wind. When the wind travels to its maximum range or hits an enemy, it creates a vortex, dealing skill damage.

skills.name: Gust Surge
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 9 Seconds Cooldown

Yumin summons a gust of wind, dealing skill damage to enemies and slowing them. When this skill is used on a Wind Zone, it creates a strong wind, dealing skill damage to enemies and knocking them back.

skills.name: Cloud Steps
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 11 Seconds Cooldown Passive: Cooldown is reduced upon hitting an enemy with a skill. Yumin leaps in the targeted direction, creating a Wind Zone that lasts for a set duration. After landing, he releases a gust to nearby enemies, dealing skill damage. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Wind Flow
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Yumin summons a crane from the sky, dealing skill damage to enemies and slowing them. After 1 second, the crane takes flight again, dealing skill damage and knocking enemies airborne.

skills.name: A Sword's Memory
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

<color=green>Passive:</color> Hisui's basic attacks are unaffected by additional attack speed. Instead, her basic attack speed increases per level. Additionally, Hisui's additional attack speed grants her additional attack power. Each time Hisui uses a skill, she gains a stack of <color=white>A Sword's Memory</color>. Basic attacks consume stacks of <color=white>A Sword's Memory</color>, reducing the cooldown of <color=white>Rengeki</color> and <color=white>Getsurin Slash</color> and increasing her movement speed.

skills.name: Rengeki
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 10 Seconds Cooldown Hisui swings her Uchigatana, dealing skill damage. She then slams it down, dealing skill damage and slowing her target. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Iaido Strike
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

<color=green>Passive:</color> Landing a skill attack grants Hisui a stack of <color=white>Iaido</color>. This skill changes depending on the number of <color=white>Iaido</color> stacks and cannot be used without stacks. <color=white>1 Stack - Clear Cut: Hisui draws her sword, dealing skill damage, and then sheaths it, dealing skill damage in the same area. Hitting an enemy with the draw grants her a shield, which increases per test subject hit. <color=white>2 Stacks - Flash Cut: Hisui deals skill damage to all her enemies in her path. She then reappears behind the farthest enemy hit, dealing skill damage and knocking the target airborne. <color=white>3 Stacks - Nichirin Cut: Hisui becomes untargetable and slashes all her enemies within range, dealing skill damage multiple times and healing for a portion of her damage dealt. Her final attack deals skill damage and she heals for a portion of her damage dealt.

skills.name: Getsurin Slash
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 15 Seconds Cooldown Hisui dashes backward and draws her Wakizashi. She then slashes forward, dealing skill damage to all enemies in her path and at her final position. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Monohoshizao/Tsubame Gaeshi!
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 65 Seconds Cooldown

Hisui unsheathes her Monohoshizao, empowering herself. During this time, her basic attack range is increased and her basic attacks and skills deal additional damage. This skill can be recast while active. <color=white>Recast:</color> Hisui prepares herself and slashes forward twice, dealing skill damage with each strike and slowing the target. She then delivers a lethal finishing strike in the central area, dealing true damage and instantly executing enemies with low HP.

skills.name: Astra Energy
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Justyna can store energy, which is consumed when using <color=white>Barrage & Annihilation</color> and <color=white>Boost Dash</color>. She passively recovers energy and if her energy drops below a certain threshold, she starts Recharging. Recharging: While Recharging, Justyna cannot use her basic skills and she recovers energy over time. <color=#ffffC2>Justice Served:</color> When Justyna deals skill damage to marked targets, the mark is consumed, dealing additional skill damage. Nearby enemies take 100 % of the additional skill damage if they are marked and 50% if they are unmarked. Each time a mark is consumed, Justyna recovers energy. The energy recovered when used on wild animals is reduced.

skills.name: Barrage & Annihilation
skills.tooltip:
Resource Cost: 50 / 1 Seconds Cooldown

Justyna fires energy beams twice in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage. The skill can be recast within a designated period of time. Recast: Justyna fires a powerful energy blast in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage and slowing enemies for a designated period of time. Hitting an enemy with this skill reduces the cooldown of <color=white>Full Blast</color>.

skills.name: Full Blast
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 11 Seconds Cooldown
