Justyna releases a full blast in the targeted area twice, dealing skill damage and slowing enemies. Enemies hit are marked for a designated period of time.

skills.name: Boost Dash
skills.tooltip:
Resource Cost: 50 / 3 Seconds Cooldown

Justyna dashes in the targeted direction and enhances her next basic attack for a designated period of time, dealing additional skill damage. Each recast of the skill within a designated period of time increases the energy cost. The energy cost resets when Justyna starts Recharging. This skill can also be used while casting <color=white>Barrage & Annihilation</color> or <color=white>Full Blast</color>.

skills.name: Astra Burst!
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Justyna leaps into the air, becoming Untargetable, and unleashes an Astra bombardment, dealing skill damage to enemies within the targeted area. While casting, she can move at a reduced speed. She remains Untargetable until she lands.

skills.name: Calculation
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Istvan's next basic skill gains a <color=white>Variable</color> after he uses his basic attack or skills a certain number of times. Istvan's movement speed is increased after triggering a <color=white>Variable</color>.

skills.name: Observation
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 4.5 Seconds Cooldown

Istvan lunges his spear, dealing skill damage to enemies. <color=white>Variable:</color> Alter Istvan dashes forward and spins, slowing nearby enemies and dealing skill damage. He deals increased damage to enemies with low health.

skills.name: Quantum Entanglement
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 8 Seconds Cooldown

Istvan swings his spear, dealing skill damage to enemies. Hitting enemies grants him a shield. <color=white>Variable:</color> Alter Istvan dashes forward and swings his spear, dealing skill damage to enemies. Hitting enemies restores his health based on his lost HP.

skills.name: Contour Integration
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown

Istvan dashes quickly in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage to enemies in his path and reducing their defense. <color=white>Variable:</color> Alter Istvan leaps to the targeted location of <color=white>Contour Integration</color>, dealing skill damage to nearby enemies and knocking them airborne.

skills.name: Wave Function Collapse
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Istvan leaps toward his targeted enemy character, dealing skill damage and slowing them. During this time he's Unstoppable and slowed enemies slowly recover speed. He then creates <color=white>Three Variables</color> around his enemy. <color=white>Three Variables:</color> After a short delay, three Alter Istvans dash toward the center, dealing skill damage to enemies in range.

skills.name: K.O.
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Whenever NiaH’s basic attacks or skills deal damage to an enemy, she applies a stack of <color=white>K.O.</color> that stores a portion of the damage dealt. If the stored damage from the <color=white>K.O.</color> stack exceeds the target’s combined HP and Shield when applied, the enemy is executed.

skills.name: Arcade Drop
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 6 Seconds Cooldown

NiaH drops an <color=white>Arcade Block</color> at the targeted location, dealing skill damage and reducing the cooldown of <color=white>Point Sink</color>. <color=white>Arcade Blocks</color> are pulled toward the location of a placed <color=white>Point Sink</color>, dealing skill damage and reducing the movement speed of enemies along its path. If the moving <color=white>Arcade Block</color> hits an enemy, the cooldown of <color=white>Arcade Drop</color> is reduced.

skills.name: Point Sink
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown

NiaH installs a <color=white>Point Sink</color> at the targeted location, dealing skill damage and pulling enemies in the area toward the center. When an Arcade Block reaches the placed <color=white>Point Sink</color>, it deals true damage in the area and removes the Arcade Block.

skills.name: 1UP
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 32 Seconds Cooldown

NiaH applies a <color=white>1UP</color> buff onto herself. While <color=white>1UP</color> is active, if she takes lethal damage, she enters a state where she does not die and recovers HP. After the recovery is complete, her movement speed is increased.

skills.name: NiaH's Game World
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

<color=green>Passive</color>: Whenever NiaH deals skill damage to enemy characters, she gains <color=white>Battery</color> stacks. When she casts <color=white>NiaH’s Game World</color>, she gains a shield based on her <color=white>Battery</color> stacks and consumes all of them. NiaH manifests a <color=white>Game World</color> in front of her, entering a channeling state with crowd control immunity. Enemies that cross its edge are stunned. Each time NiaH deals skill damage to enemies inside the <color=white>Game World</color>, its duration is extended. Repeated hits trigger additional skill damage to all enemies within the <color=white>Game World</color>.

skills.name: The Chosen One
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Hitting with basic attacks or skills, grants her a stack of <color=white>Lingering Blade</color>. At 3 stacks, her next basic attack is enhanced, throwing her energy sword at the target and dealing additional skill damage. The cooldown of <color=white>Flying Sword</color> and <color=white>TFTH</color> are reduced and she recovers HP.

skills.name: Flying Sword
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 13 Seconds Cooldown

Xuelin throws her energy sword, dealing skill damage to enemies along its path. When it reaches the designated location, it spins for a certain amount of time, dealing consecutive skill damage to enemies within range. Touching the spinning energy sword retrieves it, restoring some of <color=white>TFTH</color>’s cooldown. The retrieved sword then orbits Xuelin for a certain amount of time, dealing consecutive skill damage to enemies within range.

skills.name: Sacred Sword
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 21 Seconds Cooldown

Xuelin is guarded by the manifested swords, becoming immune to crowd control and taking no damage for a certain amount of time. She then throws a sword in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage to the first enemy character hit and slowing them. If immobilizing effects are blocked during this time, she gains 3 stacks of <color=white>Lingering Blade</color>, deals skill damage and stuns the target instead of slowing them.

skills.name: TFTH (Too Fast To Hit)
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

Xuelin dashes in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage to enemies along the path and slowing them. After the dash, an energy sword falls along the path, dealing skill damage to enemies within the area.

skills.name: Return of the Blades
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Xuelin creates an electromagnetic field of swords, dealing damage. The field remains for a certain amount of time. Whenever Xuelin deals damage with basic attacks or separate skills to an enemy within the field, an energy sword strikes the target, dealing additional skill damage. The 5th falling sword is enhanced, striking the target, dealing additional skill damage nearby and slowing them. When Xuelin arrives outside the field after using <color=white>TFTH</color>, the energy swords at the edge of the field return to her, dealing skill damage to enemies along the path. Starting from the 2nd hit, damage is reduced.

skills.name: Time Fracture
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown

When Henry deals a certain amount of damage to an enemy character within a short time, he attaches a timer to them. When the timer ends, it deals skill damage proportional to the target’s lost HP.

skills.name: Clock Hands
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 9 Seconds Cooldown

Henry throws the minute hand in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage to enemies in its path. The skill can be reused within a certain amount of time. Recast: Henry throws the hour hand in the targeted direction, dealing greater skill damage to enemies in its path. From the second enemy hit, each skill deals reduced damage. Immobilized targets take additional true damage.

skills.name: Chronograph
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 11 Seconds Cooldown

Henry creates a <color=white>Chronograph</color> at the targeted location. Enemies standing on it take skill damage every certain amount of time and are slowed. Hitting an Enemy Character or Boss Monster reduces the skill’s cooldown.

skills.name: Time Jump
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown

Henry channels and rapidly rewinds time to teleport to the targeted location. If he lands on a <color=white>Chronograph</color>, enemies on it are rooted and take skill damage. If he lands when an enemy character is standing on it, Henry's movement speed increases briefly, decaying over time. When he starts teleporting, the cooldowns of <color=white>Clock Hands</color> and <color=white>Chronograph</color> are reduced.

skills.name: Chrono Field
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Henry becomes immune to crowd control and generates a field around himself for a period of time, dealing skill damage, and gaining a shield. While the field remains, enemies and their projectiles are slowed. When the timer ends, the field explodes, destroying enemy projectiles, dealing skill damage to enemies and stunning them.

skills.name: Blade Shift
skills.tooltip: No Cost Passive: Blair's weapon has 2 forms. Dual Swords, increases her attack speed and performs two consecutive basic attacks. Double Bladed Sword, increases her basic attack range and performs a single basic attack. Use Shift Rush, Endless Hunt to switch between Dual Swords and Double Bladed Sword. When her weapon changes, Blair starts Shifting, enhancing her next basic skill and recovering some of the damage dealt as HP. She also recovers VP on hit. Skill cooldowns during Shifting are independent from the alternate form variant. Additionally, when Blair uses a skill, her next basic attack is enhanced, dealing additional skill damage, reducing the remaining cooldown of her basic skills and recovering VP. Healing from Wild Animals is reduced.

skills.name: Double Strike / Double Swing
skills.tooltip:
VP: 60 / 10 Seconds Cooldown

<color=white>Dual Swords:</color> Blair slams her dual swords down, dealing skill damage. She then swings through the front with her swords, dealing additional skill damage. <color=white>Double Bladed Sword:</color> Blair swings her double bladed sword forward twice, each dealing skill damage. She also recovers HP on hit.

skills.name: Execution / Bladestorm
skills.tooltip:
VP: 30 / 10 Seconds Cooldown

<color=white>Dual Swords:</color> Blair slashes forward with her dual swords, dealing skill damage. The first enemy hit takes increased damage and their defense is reduced. <color=white>Double Bladed Sword:</color> Blair swings her double bladed sword, becoming briefly immune to damage from the targeted direction and periodically dealing skill damage to enemies within the area.

skills.name: Cleave / Countercut
skills.tooltip:
VP: 40 / 11 Seconds Cooldown

<color=white>Dual Swords:</color> Blair swings her dual swords, dealing skill damage to enemies in a circular area and slowing them. <color=white>Combo Attack</color>: When <color=white>Shift Rush</color>’s <color=white>Combo Attack</color> is triggered through <color=white>Cleave</color>, enemies hit by the <color=white>Combo Attack</color> are slowed. <color=white>Double Bladed Sword:</color> Blair swings her double bladed sword, dealing skill damage to enemies in a circular area and gaining a shield. <color=white>Combo Attack</color>: When <color=white>Shift Rush</color>’s <color=white>Combo Attack</color> is triggered through <color=white>Countercut</color>, Blair gains a shield proportional to the targets hit by the <color=white>Combo Attack</color>.

skills.name: XMS-5 Activation / Endless Hunt
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Blair becomes briefly empowered, entering a state where she can <color=white>detect</color> VF Awakeners. Her enhanced physical abilities increase her VP recovery and attack speed. Skills that do not consume <color=white>Shift</color> from <color=white>Blade Shift</color> apply HP recovery. <color=white>Detection</color>: Enemy characters within Blair’s vision range are marked as <color=white>Detected</color>. If a <color=white>Detected</color> target leaves Blair’s vision range or moves away a certain distance, she can still visually track their direction. <color=white>Detected</color> is removed when <color=white>XMS-5 Activation</color> ends or when Blair moves far away. Blair can use <color=white>Endless Hunt</color> near a <color=white>Detected</color> target. <color=white>Endless Hunt</color>: Blair consumes all her VP to rapidly dash toward the <color=white>Detected</color> target’s location, dealing skill damage proportional to the VP consumed upon arrival. If a target is hit, she recovers VP.

skills.name: Shift Rush
skills.tooltip: VP: 40 / 0.2 Seconds Cooldown Blair dashes in the targeted direction, switching her weapon to Dual Swords or Double Bladed Sword. Combo Attack: Shift Rush can be used after each skill attack, dealing skill damage at the dash’s arrival point and recovering a portion of the damage dealt as HP. Using this skill consecutively consumes increased VP. Cannot go over walls. Healing from Wild Animals is reduced.

skills.name: Impulse Gauge
skills.tooltip: No Cost Mirka’s Impulse Gauge max value scales with her Max HP. The gauge gradually decreases while out of combat. When Impulse Gauge is at max value, her next Crushing Hammer or Power Strike consumes the entire gauge and is enhanced. When Mirka immobilizes an enemy, she gains Impulse Gauge, reducing the cooldown of her basic skills and dealing damage for a short duration. Even if multiple enemies are immobilized, the gauge gain and cooldown reduction are only applied once.

skills.name: Crushing Hammer
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 2 Seconds Cooldown (10 Seconds Charging Time)

Mirka slams her hammer down with full force, dealing skill damage to the enemy and slowing them. <color=white>Crushing Hammer - Enhanced</color>: She deals additional damage proportional to the Impulse Gauge and stuns enemies. Shortly after, two aftershocks occur at the location, dealing damage and slowing enemies.

skills.name: Impulse Barrier
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 10 Seconds Cooldown

Mirka dashes forward a short distance and gains a shield that absorbs damage. She gains <color=white>Impulse Gauge</color> equal to the amount of damage absorbed by the shield.

skills.name: Backstep Rush
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown Mirka is pushed back, then dashes forward, dealing skill damage to the enemies she collides with and knocking them back. She can then Power Strike within a short period of time. Power Strike: Mirka swings her hammer forward, dealing skill damage. Power Strike - Enhanced: She deals additional damage proportional to the Impulse Gauge and knocks back enemies hit. Cannot go over walls.

skills.name: Power Strike
skills.tooltip: No Cost

skills.name: Jumping Strike
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

After channeling, Mirka leaps into the air, becoming untargetable. For a short time, she can adjust her landing position. Upon landing, she deals skill damage to enemies within the area and knocks them airborne.

skills.name: Last Ditch
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Fenrir becomes immortal a moment after taking fatal damage. While immortal, Fenrir cannot be controlled, but his attack speed and movement speed are increased. He deals additional damage to nearby enemies based on their Max HP. When attacked by enemies, he's slowed, stacking up to 10 times. <color=white>VF Absorption</color>: Fenrir absorbs VF Energy from targets hit by Prey Pursuit or Fatal Bite for a certain period, dealing damage over time and recovering HP. He gains target vision, and the effect ends if they move beyond a certain distance.

skills.name: Rending Claws
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 5 Seconds Cooldown

Fenrir slashes powerfully with both claws, dealing skill damage to enemies in range and gaining Claw stacks. At max stacks, Fenrir slashes even more powerfully, dealing more damage, slowing enemies, and recovering HP. Hitting an enemy at max stacks reduces the cooldown of On the Hunt.

skills.name: Prey Pursuit
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

Fenrir extends his tail forward, dealing skill damage to the first enemy hit, pulling them in, and quickly moving. If a target is hit, he enters the VF Absorption state and he can use <color=white>Instinctive Retreat</color> for a certain period. <color=white>Instinctive Retreat</color>: Fenrir deals skill damage to his target and performs a backflip in the opposite direction, becoming briefly untargetable and reducing the cooldown of On the Hunt.

skills.name: Instinctive Retreat
skills.tooltip: No Cost

skills.name: On the Hunt
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

Fenrir moves towards a targeted direction, increasing his movement speed for a certain period, with an additional increase when moving toward enemy characters. After moving, his next basic attack deals additional skill damage. The movement speed increase ends immediately upon performing a basic attack.

skills.name: Fatal Bite
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Fenrir prepares to attack a designated enemy character when he uses a skill, gaining a shield. After a moment, he dashes quickly to the target, dealing skill damage and slowing them. Slowed targets recover movement speed gradually until it returns to normal. Fenrir starts VF Absorption with the hit target.

skills.name: End of Suffering
skills.tooltip: No Cost

skills.name: Causality’s Reflection
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Coraline leaves a Mirror Shard Mark whenever she hits an enemy with a skill. Hitting an enemy with a mark consumes it and deals true damage.

skills.name: Flash of Condemnation
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 8 Seconds Cooldown

Coraline fires a beam of light in the targeted direction. The beam of light flies to the end of its range or explodes upon hitting an enemy, dealing skill damage to enemies in the area. The beam of light is enhanced when it touches a mirror. <color=white>White Mirror</color>: Fires a beam of light in the mirror's direction, dealing skill damage proportional to the target's current HP and slowing them. <color=white>Black Mirror</color>: Fires a beam of light in the mirror's direction, dealing skill damage proportional to the target's lost HP and slowing them.

skills.name: Mirror of Truth / Mirror of Falsehood
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 6 Seconds Cooldown

<color=green>Passive:</color> When <color=white>Flash of Condemnation</color> or <color=white>Shackles of Sin</color> reach Coraline's mirrors, her skill amplification is increased. Coraline summons a mirror at the targeted location in the selected direction. The mirror alternates between the <color=white>White Mirror</color>, which reveals the truth, and the <color=white>Black Mirror</color>, which reveals lies. Hitting an enemy with the mirror enhanced <color=white>Flash of Condemnation</color> reduces cooldown.

skills.name: Shackles of Sin
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

Coraline fires a light sphere, dealing skill damage to enemies in its path and rooting them. The sphere is enhanced when it touches a mirror. <color=white>White Mirror</color>: Fires a sphere in the mirror's direction, dealing skill damage to enemies in its path and rooting them. Coraline gains a shield upon hitting an enemy. <color=white>Black Mirror</color>: Fires a sphere in the mirror's direction, dealing skill damage to enemies in its path and rooting them. Enemies hit have their defense reduced for a short time.

skills.name: Refracted Afterimage
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 28 Seconds Cooldown

Coraline moves in the targeted direction and briefly enters the mirror's world, becoming untargetable. After passing through it, Coraline's movement speed is increased and her next basic attack is enhanced. Enhanced basic attack hits reduce the cooldown of her base skills. Skill cooldown is reduced on-hit.

skills.name: Dokkaebi Light
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Whenever Bihyung deals damage to enemies with basic attacks or skills, she gains Divine Power. When Divine Power is full, she surrounds herself with Dokkaebi Light, dealing skill damage per second to nearby enemies and increasing Bihyung's Slow Resistance.

skills.name: Ttuk-ttak!
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 9 Seconds Cooldown

Bihyung's next basic attack deals extra skill damage and recovers HP. The skill can be reused shortly after the attack is performed. <color=white>Upon Reactivation:</color> Bihyung's next basic attack deals additional skill damage, followed by 2 instances of reduced basic attack damage and additional skill damage, and recovers HP. The additional skill damage deals damage in a nearby area.

skills.name: Pay the Price!
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown

Bihyung burns a targeted location with Dokkaebi Light, dealing skill damage and slowing enemies hit. If Bihyung is within the Dokkaebi Light's area, she gains a shield and her movement speed increases.

skills.name: Winner Takes All
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 15 Seconds Cooldown

Bihyung charges, taunting enemies she collides with and dealing skill damage.

skills.name: Let's Have a Blast!
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Bihyung becomes immune to crowd control effects and leaps to a targeted location. Damage taken is reduced while using the skill. Bihyung puts on her Dokkaebi Mask and becomes giant, gaining Additional Max HP. She then slams the ground with great force, dealing skill damage and slowing enemies hit. Enemies hit in the center of the area take increased damage and experience a stronger movement speed reduction.

skills.name: Desperado
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

Craver's attack speed is fixed, and basic attacks deal additional skill damage. Craver holds a total of 6 bullets, which can be consumed by basic attacks and basic skills. When 1 bullet remains, the Magic Bullet skill is activated and he can't basic attack. Reloads upon using the Magic Bullet skill or after a certain amount of time passes. While reloaded, Craver can't basic attack or use Double Tap, Sweep Kick.

skills.name: Double Tap / Focus Shot
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 9 Seconds Cooldown

<color=white>Double Tap:</color> Fires 2 consecutive bullets in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage. <color=white>Focus Shot:</color> Fires an enhanced bullet in the targeted direction. If the bullet flies to its maximum range or hits an enemy, it deals skill damage to the target and enemies behind them. Additionally, it deals skill damage, slowing enemies for a certain amount of time.

skills.name: Sweep Kick / Backflip
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown

<color=white>Sweep Kick:</color> Craver spins, dealing skill damage 2 times to enemies within range and slowing them. While spinning, Craver's movement speed increases and his damage taken is reduced. Hitting an enemy with <color=white>Sweep Kick</color> reduces its cooldown. <color=white>Backflip:</color> Craver deals skill damage to enemies within range and knocks them airborne.

skills.name: Combat Roll / Quick Step
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 14 Seconds Cooldown

<color=white>Combat Roll:</color> Craver dashes in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage. Hitting an enemy with <color=white>Combat Roll</color> reduces its cooldown. Using <color=white>Combat Roll</color> during a reload instantly completes the reload. <color=white>Quick Step:</color> Craver retreats backward and fires a piercing bullet, dealing skill damage.

skills.name: Showdown!
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 80 Seconds Cooldown

Craver teleports to an airborne enemy character, holding them in the air for a certain amount of time while unleashing a rapid volley that deals skill damage and restores a portion of the damage dealt as HP. During this time, Craver becomes unstoppable, basic skill cooldowns are reset and all his ammo is reloaded.

skills.name: A Lady's Upbringing
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

When Lucia hits an enemy with a skill, she leaves a <color=white>Crystal</color>. Lucia's basic attacks remove the <color=white>Crystal</color>, dealing additional skill damage and increasing her movement speed. When Lucia basic attacks an enemy marked with <color=white>Crystal</color>, her attack speed is increased.

skills.name: Splendid Tale / Glorious Tale
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 5 Seconds Cooldown

Lucia fires a crystal bullet in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage to the first enemy hit. <color=white>Glorious Tale</color>: Lucia fires a beam of light in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage to all enemies in range and slowing them.

skills.name: Volley Fire!
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 8 Seconds Cooldown

Lucia summons 4 muskets to fire at nearby enemies, dealing skill damage. Enemies already hit by a musket shot take reduced damage.

skills.name: How Insolent!
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 13 Seconds Cooldown

Passive: When Lucia removes a <color=white>Crystal</color>, the cooldown of <color=white>How Insolent!</color> is reduced. Lucia dashes in the targeted direction. For a short duration afterward, <color=white>Glorious Tale</color> is activated and can be used instead of <color=white>Splendid Tale</color>.

skills.name: Musketeer's Etiquette
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 70 Seconds Cooldown

Lucia fires a powerful shot forward, dealing skill damage to enemies. Hitting an enemy marked with a <color=white>Crystal</color> removes and re-applies the <color=white>Crystal</color>, stunning them.

skills.name: Protection Sword
skills.tooltip:
No Cost

When Seres hits an enemy with a basic attack, she leaves an Obsidian Shard for a designated period of time that deals skill damage over time.

skills.name: Rush / Pierce
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 12 Seconds Cooldown

<color=white>Rush:</color> Seres dashes in a targeted direction and gains a shield. If the shield is not destroyed before its duration ends, it explodes as it disappears, dealing skill damage to enemies nearby. For a brief period after dashing, she can <color=white>Pierce</color>. <color=white>Pierce:</color> Seres thrusts her sword forward, dealing skill damage and stunning enemies.

skills.name: Crushing Array
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 13 Seconds Cooldown

Seres swings her sword, dealing skill damage, knocking back nearby enemies, and slowing them.

skills.name: Loyal Guardian
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 13 Seconds Cooldown

Seres leaps to a targeted ally's location, designating them as the guarded ally. Seres takes a portion of the damage before reduction taken by the guarded ally from enemy test subjects, and heals herself by a portion of the damage dealt by the guarded ally to enemy test subjects. If the guarded ally is Lucia, the leap range is increased, and both the damage taken and HP recovery based on damage dealt are increased. When cast on herself, her movement speed is increased.

skills.name: Oath to the Light
skills.tooltip:
No Cost / 85 Seconds Cooldown

Seres becomes unstoppable and raises her sword, providing a shield to herself and nearby allies. The shield stacks over time.

skills.name: Uppercut
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 9 Seconds Cooldown Punch your target and deal damage. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Quick Spin
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 30 Seconds Cooldown Your damage taken is reduced for a fixed amount of time and return skill damage to the attacking enemy. (Does not block attack effects.) Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Full Swing
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 25 Seconds Cooldown Swing your bat, dealing damage to your enemies and knocking them back. If the enemies hit a wall from the knockback, they take additional damage and are stunned. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Wind Cutter
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 25 Seconds Cooldown Snap your whip forward, dealing skill damage proportional to the target's current HP and slowing them. Can be reactivated for a certain amount of time. Reactivate: Strikes down with the whip in a selected direction, dealing skill damage proportional to the target's lost HP. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Smokescreen
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 25 Seconds Cooldown Throw a smokescreen at the targeted location, dealing skill damage and slowing enemies. After a short delay, an additional smokescreen expands into the outer area, dealing skill damage and slowing enemies. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Caltrops
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 25 Seconds Cooldown Throw caltrops in an area, slowing and dealing damage to enemies that step on them. Stepping on additional caltrops deals a reduced amount of damage each time. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Rain of Arrows
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 35 Seconds Cooldown Fire a volley of arrows at the targeted area, causing a hail of arrows dealing damage to enemies hit and slowing them. Enemies located at the center of the rain of arrows take more damage. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Expulsion Shot
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 25 Seconds Cooldown Fire a crossbow shot in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage to hit enemies, slowing them, and leaving a mark that explodes after a certain amount of time to deal damage. Hitting an enemy with a mark using basic attacks or skills reduces the remaining explosion time and increases its damage. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Moving Reload
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 35 Seconds Cooldown Your movement speed is increased. You cannot basic attack while moving. Once your movement ends, a fixed number of your next basic attacks has increased attack speed. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Overheat
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 15 Seconds Cooldown When hitting an enemy with a basic attack, you gain an Overheat stack for each bullet. If you do not use a basic attack for a certain time, you start to lose stacks. Using the skill puts you in an Overheat state, dealing extra basic attack damage, increasing your attack speed and ignoring the attack speed cap. Overheat's duration and extra basic attack damage are increased based on the number of Overheat stacks. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Ballistic Advantage
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 35 Seconds Cooldown Activate Ballistic Advantage in the specified direction. Fire Crippling Shot and Dead to Rights in the targeted direction within your vision range to deal damage. Ballistic Advantage ends if you move or get hit by crowd control effects. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Armor Piercing
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 30 Seconds Cooldown Smash the hammer in a targeted direction, dealing damage and reducing the defense of enemies. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Maleficent Helix
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 7 Seconds Cooldown While moving in the targeted direction, swing your Axe to deal damage to all enemies within range, and restore your HP based on damage dealt. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Cloak and Dagger
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 30 Seconds Cooldown Cloak: Increases movement speed for a certain amount of time. Dagger: Move behind a targeted enemy, dealing skill damage and slowing them. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Parry
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 30 Seconds Cooldown Raise your sword and take a defensive position, taking reduced damage and becoming immune to crowd control effects. After, you charge towards the attacking enemy, dealing skill damage to enemies. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Dual Sword Rampage
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 25 Seconds Cooldown Charge in the targeted direction and deal damage to all enemies in your path. If you hit an enemy, you can reactivate the skill to dash in the targeted direction. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Shadow Stab
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 30 Seconds Cooldown Powerfully lunge your spear in the targeted direction, dealing damage and knocking enemies out of range. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Breath of the Dragon
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 25 Seconds Cooldown Swing the nunchaku quickly while moving, creating a gust of wind and slowing the caster. Recast to launch the gust of wind in the targeted direction dealing damage depending on charge time. Swinging the nunchaku for more than a certain amount of time stuns enemies. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Quick Cut
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 30 Seconds Cooldown Charge towards the targeted enemy and deal damage. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Love &...
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 30 Seconds Cooldown Release a sound wave in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage to enemies hit in a straight line and slowing them. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Flash
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 25 Seconds Cooldown Flash your camera in the targeted direction, dealing skill damage. Enemies facing you take additional skill damage and are blinded. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: VF Dispersion
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 30 Seconds Cooldown Creates spheres of condensed VF energy that orbit around you. The spheres fly toward the target when hitting them with basic attacks or skills, dealing skill damage to the target and its surroundings. Damage to Wild Animals is increased. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: VF Stabilization
skills.tooltip: No Cost / 13 Seconds Cooldown Cast the skill for 1 second, gaining additional effects based on the state of his VF. Below 50: Gains VF. 50 or higher: Consume VF to reduce the cooldown of all non-weapon skills and increase your movement speed. During VF Overflow: The duration of VF Overflow is increased, the cooldown of all skills, excluding VF Stabilization, is reduced, and his movement speed is increased. During Exuviation: The duration of Exuviation is reduced. Fixed Cooldown: This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.
